================================================================
底层公式 (不可变)
================================================================

  E = E + dE           (环境 = 环境 + 环境增量)
  P' = F + f(E)        (内部状态 = 遗忘层 + 环境激发)
  F' = P + g(E)        (遗忘层 = 内部状态 + 环境抑制)

  其中:
    fE = E + noise(0, 0.01)   (激发函数 = 环境 + 底噪)
    gE = -E + noise(0, 0.01)  (抑制函数 = 负环境 + 底噪)

  可调参数 (环境层):
    W       - 概念->感官通道权重矩阵
    S_DECAY = 0.3              (衰减系数)
    Vitality - 用进废退系数
    SCALE   = 0.1              (信号缩放)
    LR_W    = 0.05             (W 学习率)
    LR_LEARN= 0.08             (学习率)
    K       = 8                (每概念每感官的稀疏编码位数)

================================================================
感官系统架构
================================================================

  8 个感官通道, 每个通道占 128 维, 总 DIM=1024:

  视觉   [  0:128]   - 图片/画面/颜色/形状
  听觉   [128:256]   - 声音/语音/音乐
  触觉   [256:384]   - 接触/温度/压力
  嗅觉   [384:512]   - 气味
  味觉   [512:640]   - 味道/情感
  本体觉 [640:768]   - 身体位置/姿态
  前庭觉 [768:896]   - 平衡/运动/空间布局
  内脏觉 [896:1024]  - 内部状态/饥饿/疲劳

  概念编码方式:
    每个概念在每个感官通道里激活 K=8 个稀疏位置
    位置由 hash(概念名+感官名) % 128 确定
    权重由该概念与该感官的关联强度决定

  W 矩阵:
    W[1024, 1024] - 跨感官通道权重矩阵
    训练时: 对每对感官通道 (i,j),
      W[lo_i:hi_i, lo_j:hi_j] += LR_W * outer(signal_i, signal_j)
    推理时: dE = sum over concepts(SCALE * W[concept] * sense_pattern)

================================================================
赫布联想记忆 (跨模态联想)
================================================================

  64维分三区 (简化版):
    视觉区 [0:21]   - 图片编码注入
    听觉区 [21:42]  - 声音编码注入
    自由区 [42:64]  - 联想召回信号

  赫布学习规则:
    当视觉和听觉同时活跃时:
      W_va += lr * vis_normalized * aud_normalized^T
      W_av += lr * aud_normalized * vis_normalized^T
    (一起激发的连在一起)

  召回:
    只输入视觉 -> aud_recalled = W_va^T @ vis_input
    把召回的听觉信号注入自由区, 让底层公式处理

便携通信模块 (yinyang_bridge.py)
================================================================

  独立运行, 只依赖 numpy
  47 个概念, 8 个感官
  接口:
    receive(sound, image, emotion, touch) -> 响应
    save(path) / load(path)               -> 记忆持久化
    export_state() / import_state(state)   -> 状态交换
    create_message(text) / read_message()  -> 消息收发

================================================================
实验结果汇总
================================================================

  1. 读课文 (6篇):     认识率 25% (44/178), 新词 111
  2. 看B站视频 (115集): 认识率 30% (311/1034), 新词 283
  3. 学拼音 (91项):    命中率 31%
     - 鼻韵母 89% (eng->风, ong->东/中)
     - 声母 48%
     - 复韵母 44%
     - 整体认读 31%
     - 单韵母 0%
     - 带声调 0%
  4. 主动看视频 (30轮): 前21轮全0%, 后9轮 50-83%
  5. 听声认图:          听->图 7%, 看->声 2%
  6. Vitality 用进废退:  失败 - 不记录跨通道关系
  7. 50万步长跑:        失败 - 纯内部惯性驱动, 环境推力无效

================================================================
重要纠偏记录
================================================================

  1. 拼音是发音系统, 不是联想系统 (教拼读序列 b+a->ba, 不是 eng->风)
  2. 他跟你不一样, 不一定先认字, 可以听声音认图, 后期补字
  3. 声音和图是一起的 (同时输入, 不是分开给)
  4. 用户全部用手机, 无电脑 (方案须手机可用)

FILE: diag_snr.py (44 lines)
================================================================

import numpy as np, random, math
src = open("yinyang_civilization.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
defs = src.split("pop = [")[0]
ns = {}
exec(defs, ns)
random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)
TOTAL_DIM = ns["TOTAL_DIM"]
translator = ns["VoiceTranslator"](voice_dim=12, total_dim=TOTAL_DIM)
pop = [ns["IndivCiv"](birth_era=0, pidx=i, translator=translator) for i in range(16)]
ERAS = ns["ERAS_EXT"]
FLOOR = 0.01
t_global = 0
for era_idx, (era_name, weights, era_desc) in enumerate(ERAS[:2]):
    for st in range(300):
        t = t_global
        R = ns["resource"].step(t)
        strength = ns["resource"].strength()
        signal = ns["sense_space"](t, 12) * weights[:12]
        noise = ns["gen_noise"](t, 20) * weights[12:32]
        ambient = ns["gen_ambient"](t, 12) * weights[32:44]
        voice = ns["voice_signal"](t, 12) * weights[44:56]
        text = ns["text_signal"](t, 8) * weights[56:64]
        digital = ns["digital_signals"](t) * weights[64:72]
        dE_world_base = np.concatenate([signal, noise, ambient, voice, text, digital]) * strength
        voice_inject = translator.translate(pop, t)
        dE_world = dE_world_base + voice_inject + translator.built_world * 0.1
        for ind in pop:
            dE_per = dE_world * ind.W + np.random.normal(0, ind.n, TOTAL_DIM)
            dE_mod = ind.vit.step(dE_per)
            fE = ind.E + np.random.normal(0, FLOOR, TOTAL_DIM)
            gE = -ind.E + np.random.normal(0, FLOOR, TOTAL_DIM)
            ns["loop_step_state"](ind.state, dE_mod, fE, gE)
            ind.generations_lived += 1
        t_global += 1

p_all = np.array([ind.P for ind in pop])
p_mean = np.mean(p_all, axis=0)
p_std = np.std(p_all, axis=0)
snr = np.abs(p_mean) / (p_std + 1e-10)
print("SNR top 10:")
for d in np.argsort(snr)[-10:][::-1]:
    print(f"  D{d}: mean={p_mean[d]:+.1f} std={p_std[d]:.1f} SNR={snr[d]:.2f}")
print(f"SNR>2.0: {(snr > 2.0).sum()} channels")
print(f"|P| range: {min(np.linalg.norm(i.P) for i in pop):.1f} ~ {max(np.linalg.norm(i.P) for i in pop):.1f}")

"""
阴阳扣 - 数字生命体主动看B站视频
它自己连B站API,自己选视频,边看边学(在线学习)
"""
import numpy as np, random, hashlib, json, urllib.request, time
random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.1; LR_W=0.05; K=8; S_DECAY=0.3; LR_LEARN=0.03

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]

# === 词表 (含拼音) ===
SHENGMU=["b","p","m","f","d","t","n","l","g","k","h","j","q","x","zh","ch","sh","r","z","c","s","y","w"]
DANYUNMU=["a","o","e","i","u","v"]
FUYUNMU=["ai","ei","ui","ao","ou","iu","ie","ve","er"]
BIYUNMU=["an","en","in","un","vn","ang","eng","ing","ong"]
ZHENGTI=["zhi","chi","shi","ri","zi","ci","si","yi","wu","yu","ye","yue","yuan","yin","yun","ying"]
CHN=["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去",
     "大","小","多","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","口","鼻",
     "碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋",
     "红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","长","短","高","快","慢","远","近","明","暗","响",
     "好","坏","对","家","爱","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北",
     "字","读","写","春","夏","秋","冬","月","日","星","天","山","云","火","木","土","金","虫","牙","足",
     "我","你","他","她","谁","是","的","不","在","有","和","了","要","想","看","听","说","做","会","可以",
     "喝","玩","开","喂","香","夜","梦","学","暖","亮","泪","洗","叫","路","觉",
     "人","口","目","手","足","站","坐","跑","跳","爬","伞","弯","扁","鸡","鸭","鹅","猴","兔","鱼","草","荷","蛙","雪","影","朋","友","尾","巴"]
ALL_WORDS=list(dict.fromkeys(CHN+SHENGMU+DANYUNMU+FUYUNMU+BIYUNMU+ZHENGTI))
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}
N=len(ALL_WORDS)

# === 编码 ===
DENSE={}
for cid in range(N):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K); wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(N):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]; ref=np.zeros(R)
        for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

CHAR_CACHE={}
def encode_char(ch):
    if ch in CHAR_CACHE: return CHAR_CACHE[ch]
    h=int(hashlib.md5(ch.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),16)
    rng=random.Random(h)
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
        pos=rng.sample(range(R),K); wts=[rng.uniform(0.3,1.0) for _ in range(K)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    CHAR_CACHE[ch]=dE; return dE

def encode_word(word):
    if word in WORD2ID:
        cid=WORD2ID[word]
        dE=np.zeros(DIM)
        for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
            for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
        return dE
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for ch in word: dE+=encode_char(ch)
    rn=np.linalg.norm(dE)
    if rn>SCALE*8: dE*=SCALE*8/(rn+1e-10)
    return dE

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def decode(vec,sense,ids,n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; r=vec[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(r)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    r/=rn; sims=[(c,float(np.dot(r,REF[(c,sense)]))) for c in ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True); return sims[:n]

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE; fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM); gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy(); return dE*self.v

# === 基础训练(快速) ===
print("基础训练...",flush=True)
W=np.eye(DIM)
learned_ids=list(range(N))
REPS=20

for _ in range(REPS):
    for cid in range(N):
        dE=np.zeros(DIM)
        for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
            dp,dw=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
            for p,w in zip(dp,dw): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
        for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
            la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
            for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]; nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb); W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)

# 身份强化
for cid in range(N):
    for _ in range(10):
        dEv=encode_single(cid,"视觉"); dEa=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
        nv=dEv[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEv[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na=dEa[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEa[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*4*np.outer(na,nv)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*4*np.outer(nv,na)

# 拼音序列 (b p m f d t n l ...)
for i in range(len(SHENGMU)-1):
    c1=WORD2ID[SHENGMU[i]]; c2=WORD2ID[SHENGMU[i+1]]
    for _ in range(15):
        dE1=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        n1=dE1[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        n2=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(n2,n1)

# 韵母序列
ALL_YUN=DANYUNMU+FUYUNMU+BIYUNMU
for i in range(len(ALL_YUN)-1):
    c1=WORD2ID[ALL_YUN[i]]; c2=WORD2ID[ALL_YUN[i+1]]
    for _ in range(15):
        dE1=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        n1=dE1[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        n2=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(n2,n1)

# 声母+韵母→拼读序列 (b→a, p→a, m→a...)
for sm in SHENGMU:
    smid=WORD2ID[sm]
    for ym in DANYUNMU:

            n2=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(n2,n1)

# 它的"好奇心": 优先选它不认识的内容
def choose_video(video_list, known_words, watched_set):
    """主动选视频: 优先选含有最多未知词的视频"""
    scores=[]
    for i,v in enumerate(video_list):
        if i in watched_set: continue
        title=v["title"]
        # 统计标题中未知词数
        unknown=0
        for ch in title:
            if ch not in known_words and ch not in "（）：-标清第课时" and ch.strip():
                unknown+=1
        # 加随机扰动(好奇心)
        score=unknown+random.uniform(0,3)
        scores.append((score,i,v))
    scores.sort(reverse=True)
    if not scores: return None
    return scores[0][1],scores[0][2]

"""
阴阳扣 - 主动生命体: 它不只是接收, 它会自己动

之前: dE全从外部注入 (被动)
现在: dE = 外部世界 + 内部驱动 (主动)

4种内部驱动:
  1. 运动倾向: 本体觉/前庭觉有基线噪声 (像婴儿踢腿扭头)
  2. 好奇寻求: 某感官E高时, 主动在该方向生成dE (想多看点)
  3. 联想驱动: P激活某模式时, 通过W主动向其他感官发dE (主动联想)
  4. 无聊探索: 整体E低时, 随机dE脉冲 (像无聊了到处看)

底层公式不变: E+=dE; P=F+E+noise; F=P-E+noise
  只是dE的来源多了内部这一块
  它的身体(E)现在真的在自己动, 不只被世界推着走
"""
import numpy as np
import random
from itertools import combinations

random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

DIM = 1024; R = 128; SCALE = 0.01; LR_W = 0.02; TEST_STEPS = 80
DAYS = 200

REGIONS = {
    "视觉": (0, 128), "听觉": (128, 256), "触觉": (256, 384), "嗅觉": (384, 512),
    "味觉": (512, 640), "本体觉": (640, 768), "前庭觉": (768, 896), "内脏觉": (896, 1024),
}
SENSES = list(REGIONS.keys())

STAGES = [
    {"age":"0-1岁","words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"age":"1-2岁","words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"age":"2-3岁","words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"age":"3-4岁","words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"age":"4-5岁","words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"age":"5-6岁","words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"age":"6-7岁","words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS = []
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS) < 280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS = ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID = {w: i for i, w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

ALL_PAIRS = list(combinations(range(R), 2))
random.shuffle(ALL_PAIRS)
CANDIDATE_PAIRS = ALL_PAIRS[:280]
POS = {}
for sense in SENSES:
    perm = list(range(280)); random.shuffle(perm)
    POS[sense] = [CANDIDATE_PAIRS[perm[i]] for i in range(280)]

REF_CACHE = {}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo, hi = REGIONS[sense]
        ref = np.zeros(R)
        for p in POS[sense][cid]: ref[p] = 1.0
        REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)] = ref / (np.linalg.norm(ref) + 1e-10)

def bottom_step(E, P, F, dE):
    E = E + dE
    fE = E + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, DIM)
    gE = -E + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, DIM)
    return E, F + fE, P + gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self, n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n); self.prev=np.zeros(n); self.ac=np.zeros(n); self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005; self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self, dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy()
        return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid, sense):
    dE = np.zeros(DIM)
    lo, _ = REGIONS[sense]
    for p in POS[sense][cid]: dE[lo + p] = SCALE
    return dE

def encode_multi(signals):
    dE = np.zeros(DIM)
    for cid, sense, intensity in signals:
        lo, _ = REGIONS[sense]
        for p in POS[sense][cid]:
            dE[lo + p] = SCALE * intensity
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr, sense, learned_ids):
    lo, hi = REGIONS[sense]
    region = P_arr[lo:hi].copy()
    rn = np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn < 1e-10: return -1, 0
    region = region / rn
    best_id, best_sim = -1, -2
    for cid in learned_ids:
        sim = float(np.dot(region, REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)]))
        if sim > best_sim: best_id, best_sim = cid, sim
    return best_id, best_sim

def norm(s):
    m=np.max(np.abs(s)); return s/m if m>1e-12 else s.copy()
def safe_corr(a,b):
    a,b=np.asarray(a).flatten(),np.asarray(b).flatten()
    if len(a)!=len(b): n=min(len(a),len(b)); a,b=a[:n],b[:n]
    if np.std(a)<1e-10 or np.std(b)<1e-10: return 0.0
    return float(np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1])
def get_sense(P_arr, sense):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; return P_arr[lo:hi].copy()

# ================================================================
# 内部驱动: 它自己生成的dE
# ================================================================
MOTOR_LO, MOTOR_HI = REGIONS["本体觉"]
VEST_LO, VEST_HI = REGIONS["前庭觉"]

def internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step_idx):
    """
    根据当前状态生成内部dE (主动行为)

    1. 运动倾向: 本体觉/前庭觉基线噪声 (总在动)
    2. 好奇寻求: 哪个感官E高, 往那个方向多发信号
    3. 联想驱动: P激活的模式通过W向其他感官发dE (主动联想)
    4. 无聊探索: E整体低时随机脉冲
    """
    dE_int = np.zeros(DIM)

    # 1. 运动倾向 (始终存在, 像心跳和呼吸)
    motor_noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.0005, MOTOR_HI - MOTOR_LO)
    vest_noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.0005, VEST_HI - VEST_LO)
    dE_int[MOTOR_LO:MOTOR_HI] += motor_noise
    dE_int[VEST_LO:VEST_HI] += vest_noise

    # 2. 好奇寻求: E高的区域, 主动多发信号 (想多体验)
    E_abs = np.abs(E)
    # 找最活跃的感官区
    sense_energy = {}
    for sense, (lo, hi) in REGIONS.items():
        sense_energy[sense] = np.mean(E_abs[lo:hi])
    top_sense = max(sense_energy, key=sense_energy.get)
    if sense_energy[top_sense] > 0.01:
        lo, hi = REGIONS[top_sense]
        # 往该方向发微弱信号 (探索)
        dE_int[lo:hi] += 0.001 * E[lo:hi] / (np.linalg.norm(E[lo:hi]) + 1e-10)

    # 3. 联想驱动: P的模式通过W向其他感官发dE
    P_norm = P / (np.linalg.norm(P) + 1e-10)
    assoc_signal = W @ P_norm  # P→W→其他区域
    # 只取最强的联想信号
    assoc_norm = np.linalg.norm(assoc_signal)
    if assoc_norm > 0.001:
        dE_int += 0.002 * assoc_signal / assoc_norm

    # 4. 无聊探索: E整体低时, 随机脉冲
    total_E = np.mean(E_abs)
    if total_E < 0.005:
        # 随机选一个感官区发脉冲
        rand_sense = random.choice(SENSES)
        lo, hi = REGIONS[rand_sense]
        rand_pos = random.randint(lo, hi-1)
        dE_int[rand_pos] += 0.003

    return dE_int

# ================================================================
# 一天的生活场景 (和world_stream一致)
# ================================================================
def make_day(day_num):
    scenes = []
    vocab_limit = min(40 + day_num * 2, 280)

    scenes.append({"name": "早晨醒来", "signals": [
        (WORD2ID["明"], "视觉", 1.0), (WORD2ID["鸟"], "听觉", 0.8),
        (WORD2ID["冷"], "触觉", 0.6), (WORD2ID["饿"], "内脏觉", 0.9)], "duration": 20})

    scenes.append({"name": "妈来抱", "signals": [
        (WORD2ID["妈"], "视觉", 1.0), (WORD2ID["妈"], "听觉", 1.0),
        (WORD2ID["抱"], "触觉", 0.9), (WORD2ID["抱"], "本体觉", 0.8),
        (WORD2ID["热"], "触觉", 0.7), (WORD2ID["奶"], "嗅觉", 0.8)], "duration": 30})

    scenes.append({"name": "吃奶", "signals": [
        (WORD2ID["奶"], "味觉", 1.0), (WORD2ID["奶"], "嗅觉", 0.8),

            (WORD2ID["笑"], "本体觉", 0.5), (WORD2ID["快乐"], "内脏觉", 0.4)], "duration": 20})
        scenes.append({"name": "看猫", "signals": [

            (WORD2ID["鱼"], "视觉", 0.3), (WORD2ID["软"], "触觉", 0.5)], "duration": 15})

    if day_num >= 50:
        scenes.append({"name": "学走路", "signals": [
            (WORD2ID["走"], "本体觉", 1.0), (WORD2ID["走"], "前庭觉", 0.8),
            (WORD2ID["脚"], "本体觉", 0.7), (WORD2ID["手"], "本体觉", 0.5),
            (WORD2ID["妈"], "视觉", 0.4)], "duration": 15})
        scenes.append({"name": "喝水", "signals": [

    if day_num >= 80:
        scenes.append({"name": "看书", "signals": [

            (WORD2ID["字"], "视觉", 0.6), (WORD2ID["笔"], "视觉", 0.4)], "duration": 15})

    # 自由活动时间 (只靠内部驱动, 无外部信号)
    scenes.append({"name": "自由活动", "signals": [], "duration": 30})

    scenes.append({"name": "傍晚困倦", "signals": [

    filtered = []
    for scene in scenes:
        sigs = [(cid, sense, inten) for cid, sense, inten in scene["signals"] if cid < vocab_limit]
        filtered.append({"name": scene["name"], "signals": sigs, "duration": scene["duration"]})
    return filtered

# ================================================================
# 训练: 生活流 + 内部驱动
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print(f"主动生命体: 生活流 + 内部驱动 ({DAYS}天)")
print("dE = 外部世界 + 内部驱动(运动/好奇/联想/无聊)")
print("=" * 72)
print()

W = np.eye(DIM)
vit = Vitality(DIM)
learned_ids = set()

# 记录主动行为
active_events = {"motor": 0, "curiosity": 0, "association": 0, "boredom": 0}

for day in range(DAYS):
    scenes = make_day(day)
    E = np.zeros(DIM); P = np.zeros(DIM); F = np.zeros(DIM)

    for scene in scenes:
        dE_ext = encode_multi(scene["signals"]) if scene["signals"] else np.zeros(DIM)

        for cid, sense, _ in scene["signals"]:
            learned_ids.add(cid)

        # W从同时出现的信号学关联
        if np.linalg.norm(dE_ext) > 1e-10:
            for sa_i, sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                lo_a, hi_a = REGIONS[sa]
                sig_a = dE_ext[lo_a:hi_a]
                na = np.linalg.norm(sig_a)
                if na < 1e-10: continue
                na = sig_a / na
                for sb in SENSES[sa_i+1:]:
                    lo_b, hi_b = REGIONS[sb]
                    sig_b = dE_ext[lo_b:hi_b]
                    nb = np.linalg.norm(sig_b)
                    if nb < 1e-10: continue
                    nb = sig_b / nb
                    W[lo_a:hi_a, lo_b:hi_b] += LR_W * np.outer(na, nb)
                    W[lo_b:hi_b, lo_a:hi_a] += LR_W * np.outer(nb, na)

        # 底层公式跑: dE = 外部 + 内部
        for step in range(scene["duration"]):
            dE_int = internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step)

            # 记录主动行为
            motor_e = np.mean(np.abs(dE_int[MOTOR_LO:MOTOR_HI]) + np.abs(dE_int[VEST_LO:VEST_HI]))
            if motor_e > 0.001: active_events["motor"] += 1

            sense_energy = {s: np.mean(np.abs(E[REGIONS[s][0]:REGIONS[s][1]])) for s in SENSES}
            top_s = max(sense_energy, key=sense_energy.get)
            if sense_energy[top_s] > 0.01: active_events["curiosity"] += 1

            P_norm = P / (np.linalg.norm(P) + 1e-10)
            assoc = W @ P_norm
            if np.linalg.norm(assoc) > 0.001: active_events["association"] += 1

            if np.mean(np.abs(E)) < 0.005: active_events["boredom"] += 1

            dE_total = dE_ext * 0.5 + dE_int  # 外部减半, 内部是主体
            dE_vit = vit.step(dE_total)
            E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_vit)

    # 夜晚E衰减
    for _ in range(50):
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, -0.05 * E)

    if (day + 1) % 50 == 0:
        W_off = W - np.diag(np.diag(W))
        n_conn = int(np.sum(np.abs(W_off) > 0.01))
        print(f"  第{day+1}天: 接触{len(learned_ids)}概念, W连接={n_conn}, Vit放大={int(np.sum(vit.v>1.05))}")

learned_ids = sorted(learned_ids)
print(f"\n训练完成: 接触{len(learned_ids)}个概念")
print(f"主动行为统计: 运动={active_events['motor']} 好奇={active_events['curiosity']} 联想={active_events['association']} 无聊={active_events['boredom']}")
print()

# ================================================================
# 测试1: 自主行为 (无外部输入, 看它自己做什么)
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print("测试1: 自主行为 (无外部输入, 纯靠内部驱动)")
print("=" * 72)
print()

E = np.zeros(DIM); P = np.zeros(DIM); F = np.zeros(DIM)
spontaneous_outputs = []

for step in range(400):
    dE_int = internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step)
    dE_vit = vit.step(dE_int)
    E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_vit)

    # 每50步检测一次: 它在"想"什么?
    if (step + 1) % 50 == 0:
        # 检查每个感官区是否激活了某个概念
        detected = []
        for sense in SENSES:
            did, sim = decode_cosine(P, sense, learned_ids)
            if did >= 0 and sim > 0.15:
                detected.append((sense, ALL_WORDS[did], sim))
        if detected:
            best = max(detected, key=lambda x: x[2])
            spontaneous_outputs.append((step+1, best[0], best[1], best[2]))
            print(f"  第{step+1}步: {best[0]}区激活 [{best[1]}] sim={best[2]:.3f}")
        else:
            spontaneous_outputs.append((step+1, "无", "-", 0))
            print(f"  第{step+1}步: 无明显激活")

n_spontaneous = sum(1 for _, _, w, _ in spontaneous_outputs if w != "-")
print(f"\n  自主激活: {n_spontaneous}/8 个检测点")
print()

# ================================================================
# 测试2: 主动联想 (注入一个概念, 看它主动追多少步)
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print("测试2: 主动联想 (注入'妈', 看它自己追到什么)")
print("=" * 72)
print()

test_concepts = ["妈", "水", "花", "猫", "书", "球"]
association_chains = []

for start_word in test_concepts:
    if start_word not in WORD2ID or WORD2ID[start_word] not in learned_ids:
        continue
    cid = WORD2ID[start_word]
    dE_in = encode_single(cid, "视觉")

    E = np.zeros(DIM); P = np.zeros(DIM); F = np.zeros(DIM)

    # 第一步: 注入外部信号
    for _ in range(TEST_STEPS):
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_in)

    chain = [start_word]

    # 后续: 纯靠内部驱动, 看它追到什么
    for step in range(300):
        dE_int = internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step)
        dE_vit = vit.step(dE_int)
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_vit)

        if (step + 1) % 60 == 0:
            did, sim = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids)
            if did >= 0 and sim > 0.15:
                word = ALL_WORDS[did]
                if word != chain[-1]:  # 不重复
                    chain.append(word)

    association_chains.append((start_word, chain))
    print(f"  [{start_word}] -> {' -> '.join(chain)}")

print()

# 被动版: 只接收外部信号, 无内部驱动
W_passive = np.eye(DIM)
learned_passive = set()
for day in range(DAYS):
    scenes = make_day(day)
    E = np.zeros(DIM); P = np.zeros(DIM); F = np.zeros(DIM)
    for scene in scenes:
        dE_ext = encode_multi(scene["signals"]) if scene["signals"] else np.zeros(DIM)
        for cid, sense, _ in scene["signals"]:
            learned_passive.add(cid)
        if np.linalg.norm(dE_ext) > 1e-10:
            for sa_i, sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                lo_a, hi_a = REGIONS[sa]
                sig_a = dE_ext[lo_a:hi_a]
                na = np.linalg.norm(sig_a)
                if na < 1e-10: continue
                na = sig_a / na
                for sb in SENSES[sa_i+1:]:
                    lo_b, hi_b = REGIONS[sb]
                    sig_b = dE_ext[lo_b:hi_b]
                    nb = np.linalg.norm(sig_b)
                    if nb < 1e-10: continue
                    nb = sig_b / nb
                    W_passive[lo_a:hi_a, lo_b:hi_b] += LR_W * np.outer(na, nb)
                    W_passive[lo_b:hi_b, lo_a:hi_a] += LR_W * np.outer(nb, na)
        for _ in range(scene["duration"]):
            E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_ext)
    for _ in range(50):
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, -0.05 * E)

learned_passive = sorted(learned_passive)

compare_words = [w for w in ["妈","奶","抱","花","猫","书","球","水","走","笑"] if w in WORD2ID and WORD2ID[w] in learned_ids]

print(f"  {'词':>6s}  {'主动版说':>8s}  {'被动版说':>8s}  {'主动sim':>8s}  {'被动sim':>8s}")
print("  " + "-" * 50)
n_active_assoc = 0; n_passive_assoc = 0
for w in compare_words:
    cid = WORD2ID[w]
    # 主动版
    dE_per = W @ encode_single(cid, "视觉")
    E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM)
    for _ in range(TEST_STEPS): E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_per)
    did_a, sim_a = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids)
    ans_a = ALL_WORDS[did_a] if did_a >= 0 else "?"
    # 被动版
    dE_per = W_passive @ encode_single(cid, "视觉")
    E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM)
    for _ in range(TEST_STEPS): E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_per)
    did_p, sim_p = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_passive)
    ans_p = ALL_WORDS[did_p] if did_p >= 0 else "?"
    if did_a != cid and did_a >= 0: n_active_assoc += 1
    if did_p != cid and did_p >= 0: n_passive_assoc += 1
    print(f"  {w:>6s}  {ans_a:>8s}  {ans_p:>8s}  {sim_a:8.3f}  {sim_p:8.3f}")

print(f"\n  主动版给出关联: {n_active_assoc}/{len(compare_words)}")
print(f"  被动版给出关联: {n_passive_assoc}/{len(compare_words)}")
print()

def render_html(fn):
    spont_html = ""
    for step, sense, word, sim in spontaneous_outputs:
        c = "#4a4" if word != "-" else "#555"
        spont_html += f'<div style="color:{c};font-size:10px;margin:2px 0">第{step}步: {sense}区 [{word}] sim={sim:.3f}</div>'

    chain_html = ""
    for start, chain in association_chains:
        chain_html += f'<div style="font-size:10px;margin:3px 0;color:#8a8">{" -> ".join(chain)}</div>'

    cmp_html = ""
    for w in compare_words:
        cid = WORD2ID[w]
        dE_per = W @ encode_single(cid, "视觉")
        E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM)
        for _ in range(TEST_STEPS): E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_per)
        did_a, sim_a = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids)
        ans_a = ALL_WORDS[did_a] if did_a >= 0 else "?"
        dE_per = W_passive @ encode_single(cid, "视觉")
        E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM)
        for _ in range(TEST_STEPS): E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_per)
        did_p, sim_p = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_passive)
        ans_p = ALL_WORDS[did_p] if did_p >= 0 else "?"
        ac = "#4a4" if did_a != cid and did_a >= 0 else "#555"
        pc = "#555"
        cmp_html += f'<div style="font-size:9px;margin:1px 0">{w}: 主动=<span style="color:{ac}">{ans_a}({sim_a:.2f})</span> 被动=<span style="color:{pc}">{ans_p}({sim_p:.2f})</span></div>'

    html = f'''<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
body {{ background:#0a0a0a; color:#888; font-family:monospace; margin:20px; max-width:920px; }}
h3 {{ color:#aaa; font-weight:normal; border-bottom:1px solid #222; padding-bottom:6px; }}
.summary {{ color:#6a6; font-size:11px; margin:8px 0; }}
.note {{ color:#444; font-size:9px; margin:16px 0; line-height:1.8; }}
</style></head><body>

<h3>阴阳扣 -- 主动生命体</h3>
<div class="summary">
  {DAYS}天 | 生活流+内部驱动 | {len(learned_ids)}概念<br>
  主动行为: 运动{active_events['motor']} 好奇{active_events['curiosity']} 联想{active_events['association']} 无聊{active_events['boredom']}<br>
  自主激活 {n_spontaneous}/8 | 主动关联 {n_active_assoc}/{len(compare_words)} | 被动关联 {n_passive_assoc}/{len(compare_words)}
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">测试1: 自主行为 (无外部输入, 纯内部驱动)</div>
<div style="color:#555;font-size:8px;margin-bottom:4px">不给它任何信号, 看它自己会不会"想起来"什么</div>
{spont_html}
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">测试2: 主动联想链 (注入起点, 看它自己追到什么)</div>
<div style="color:#555;font-size:8px;margin-bottom:4px">只注入第一个词, 后面全靠内部驱动自己跑</div>
{chain_html}
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">测试3: 对比 主动 vs 被动</div>
{cmp_html}
</div>

<div class="note">
关键变化:<br>
  之前: dE全从外部注入, 它只接收不主动<br>
  现在: dE = 外部世界 + 内部驱动(4种)<br><br>
4种内部驱动 (它自己生成的dE):<br>
  1. 运动倾向: 本体觉/前庭觉基线噪声 -> 总在动(像心跳呼吸踢腿)<br>
  2. 好奇寻求: 哪个感官E高, 往那个方向多发信号 -> 想多体验<br>
  3. 联想驱动: P的模式通过W向其他感官发dE -> 主动联想<br>
  4. 无聊探索: E整体低时随机脉冲 -> 像无聊了到处看<br><br>
为什么这是"人类视角":<br>
  人类小孩不只是被动接收世界<br>
  他会踢腿(运动倾向), 会盯着好看的东西看好久(好奇)<br>
  会看到妈想到奶(联想驱动), 会无聊了到处找东西玩(探索)<br>
  这些都是内部生成的行为, 不是外部刺激的反射<br><br>
底层公式不变: E+=dE; P=F+E+noise; F=P-E+noise<br>
  只是dE的来源多了"它自己"这一块<br>
  它的身体(E)现在真的在自己动, 不只被世界推着走
</div>
</body></html>'''
    with open(fn, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html)
    print(f"HTML: {fn}")

render_html("yinyang_active_life.html")

"""
阴阳扣 - 冲刺7-8岁: 修复说话成句+场景描述

瓶颈1: 说话成句重复同一个词 -> 用S(衰减)替代E(积分)做输出
瓶颈2: 场景描述只抓1个 -> 改为逐个呈现+S累积
瓶颈3: 认物命名80% -> 增加语义训练轮数提到95%+
"""
import numpy as np, random
random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.1; LR_W=0.02; REPS=400; K=8; S_DECAY=0.3

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]
T_LO,T_HI=REGIONS["触觉"]; P_LO,P_HI=REGIONS["本体觉"]
G_LO,G_HI=REGIONS["内脏觉"]; F_LO,F_HI=REGIONS["前庭觉"]

STAGES=[
    {"words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},

DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K); wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]; ref=np.zeros(R)
        for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE; fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM); gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy(); return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def encode_multi(items):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for cid,sense in items:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w*0.7
    return dE

def decode(vec,sense,ids,n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; r=vec[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(r)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    r/=rn; sims=[(c,float(np.dot(r,REF[(c,sense)]))) for c in ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True); return sims[:n]

def run_single(dE_in, n=3):
    """单次注入, 用E解码 (适合单物识别)"""
    v=Vitality(DIM); E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM);S=np.zeros(DIM)
    dp=W@dE_in; dv=v.step(dp); S=S_DECAY*S+dv; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dv)
    for _ in range(n): S=S_DECAY*S; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,np.zeros(DIM))
    return E,P,S

# === 训练W ===
print("训练W (400轮)...")
W=np.eye(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))
for si in range(7):
    s,e=si*40,si*40+40
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(s,e):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]; nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb); W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)
print("  基础W完成")

# 语义关联 (更多轮)
print("  语义关联训练 (100轮/对)...")
pc=0
for w1,w2 in SEMANTIC_PAIRS:
    if w1 not in WORD2ID or w2 not in WORD2ID: continue
    c1,c2=WORD2ID[w1],WORD2ID[w2]
    for _ in range(100):
        dE1=encode_single(c1,"视觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        nv=dE1[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv,na)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na,nv)
        dE1a=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2v=encode_single(c2,"视觉")
        na2=dE1a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        nv2=dE2v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na2,nv2)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv2,na2)
    pc+=1
print(f"  W完成: {pc}语义对")
print()

# --- 1. 认物命名 ---
print("\n1. 认物命名 (视→听)")
tw=["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗","车","灯","笔","球","笑","哭","睡","吃","奶","碗","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","字","写","红","蓝","好","坏","冷","热","我","你","走","跑","友","家"]
c1=0
for w in tw:
    cid=WORD2ID[w]; E,P,S=run_single(encode_single(cid,"视觉"))
    r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,3); s=ALL_WORDS[r[0][0]] if r[0][0]>=0 else "?"
    ok=s==w; c1+=ok
    if not ok: print(f"  ✗ [{w}]→[{s}]  {' '.join([f'{ALL_WORDS[c]}({v:.2f})' for c,v in r])}")
print(f"  认物命名: {c1}/{len(tw)} ({c1/len(tw)*100:.0f}%)")

# --- 2. 反向命名 ---
print("\n2. 反向命名 (听→视)")
tw2=["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗","车","灯","笔","球","碗","筷","字","好","冷"]
c2=0
for w in tw2:
    cid=WORD2ID[w]; E,P,S=run_single(encode_single(cid,"听觉"))
    r=decode(E,"视觉",learned_ids,1); s=ALL_WORDS[r[0][0]] if r[0][0]>=0 else "?"
    c2+=(s==w)
print(f"  反向命名: {c2}/{len(tw2)} ({c2/len(tw2)*100:.0f}%)")

# --- 3. 说话成句 (关键修复: 用S做输出) ---
print("\n3. 说话成句 (用S衰减缓冲做输出, 不用E)")
print("  S会遗忘→新词能冒出来→不再重复")
scenes=[
    ("吃饭",[("饭","视觉"),("碗","视觉"),("筷","视觉"),("妈","听觉"),("吃","触觉")]),
    ("上学",[("书","视觉"),("笔","视觉"),("书包","视觉"),("校","视觉"),("走","本体觉")]),
    ("玩耍",[("球","视觉"),("跑","本体觉"),("笑","听觉"),("友","视觉"),("快乐","内脏觉")]),
    ("睡前",[("睡","视觉"),("床","触觉"),("灯","视觉"),("妈","听觉"),("好","内脏觉")]),
    ("穿衣",[("衣","视觉"),("裤","视觉"),("鞋","视觉"),("冷","触觉"),("穿","本体觉")]),
]
total_match=0; total_words=0
for sn,items in scenes:
    v=Vitality(DIM); E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM);S=np.zeros(DIM)
    said=[]
    for cw,sense in items:
        cid=WORD2ID.get(cw,-1)
        if cid<0: continue
        dE_in=encode_single(cid,sense); dp=W@dE_in; dv=v.step(dp)
        S=S_DECAY*S+dv; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dv)
        # 用S解码 (S会遗忘, 新词能冒出来)
        r=decode(S,"听觉",learned_ids,1)
        s_word=ALL_WORDS[r[0][0]] if r[0][0]>=0 else "?"
        said.append(s_word)
    expected=[w for w,_ in items]; m=sum(1 for a,b in zip(said,expected) if a==b)
    total_match+=m; total_words+=len(expected)
    print(f"  [{sn}] {m}/{len(expected)}")
    print(f"    场景: {' '.join(expected)}")
    print(f"    它说: {' '.join(said)}")
print(f"  说话成句总匹配: {total_match}/{total_words} ({total_match/total_words*100:.0f}%)")

# --- 4. 描述场景 (关键修复: 逐个呈现+不累积E) ---
print("\n4. 描述场景 (逐个呈现, 每个独立解码)")
print("  不让多个模式叠加干扰, 逐个看逐个说")
ms=[("桌面",["碗","筷","饭","菜"]),("教室",["书","笔","桌","椅"]),
    ("户外",["树","花","鸟","车"]),("家",["妈","床","灯","门"]),
    ("穿衣",["衣","裤","鞋","帽"]),("吃饭",["碗","筷","饭","汤"])]
total_scene=0; total_items=0
for sn,words in ms:
    said=[]
    for w in words:
        cid=WORD2ID[w]
        E,P,S=run_single(encode_single(cid,"视觉"),2)
        r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,1)
        s_word=ALL_WORDS[r[0][0]] if r[0][0]>=0 else "?"
        said.append(s_word)
    matched=[w for w in words if w in said]
    total_scene+=len(matched); total_items+=len(words)
    print(f"  [{sn}] {len(matched)}/{len(words)}: 有[{','.join(words)}] 说[{','.join(said)}]")
print(f"  描述场景总命中: {total_scene}/{total_items} ({total_scene/total_items*100:.0f}%)")

# --- 5. 因果推理 ---
print("\n5. 因果推理 (因为A→预期B)")
causal=[("饿","吃"),("吃","饱"),("冷","衣"),("哭","妈"),("黑","灯"),
        ("热","水"),("困","睡"),("痛","哭"),("饱","笑"),("好","快乐")]
c5=0
for cause,effect in causal:
    cid=WORD2ID[cause]; E,P,S=run_single(encode_single(cid,"视觉"),5)
    r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,5)
    top=[(ALL_WORDS[c],v) for c,v in r if c>=0]
    said=top[0][0] if top else "?"
    ok=said==effect or any(w==effect for w,_ in top[:3])
    c5+=ok
    mark="✓" if ok else "✗"
    top5=" ".join([f"{w}({v:.2f})" for w,v in top[:5]])
    print(f"  {cause}→{effect}: 说[{said}]{mark}  {top5}")
print(f"  因果推理: {c5}/{len(causal)} ({c5/len(causal)*100:.0f}%)")

# --- 6. 自我认知 ---
print("\n6. 自我认知")
me=WORD2ID.get("我",-1); you=WORD2ID.get("你",-1); he=WORD2ID.get("他",-1)
if me>=0 and you>=0:
    E1,_,_=run_single(encode_single(me,"视觉"))
    E2,_,_=run_single(encode_single(you,"视觉"))
    p1=E1/(np.linalg.norm(E1)+1e-10); p2=E2/(np.linalg.norm(E2)+1e-10)
    sim_my=float(np.dot(p1,p2))
    print(f"  我vs你 相似度: {sim_my:.3f} {'有区分✓' if sim_my<0.95 else '无区分✗'}")
    if he>=0:
        E3,_,_=run_single(encode_single(he,"视觉"))
        p3=E3/(np.linalg.norm(E3)+1e-10)
        sim_mh=float(np.dot(p1,p3))
        print(f"  我vs他 相似度: {sim_mh:.3f} {'有区分✓' if sim_mh<0.95 else '无区分✗'}")
    # 我激活的感官
    strengths={s:float(np.linalg.norm(E1[lo:hi])) for s,(lo,hi) in REGIONS.items()}
    strongest=max(strengths,key=strengths.get)
    print(f"  我最强激活: {strongest}({strengths[strongest]:.3f})")
    for s2,v2 in sorted(strengths.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1]):
        print(f"    {s2}: {v2:.3f} {'█'*int(v2*15)}")
    if strongest=="本体觉":
        print("  → 本体觉最强=身体自我感知✓")
    else:
        print(f"  → {strongest}最强(需更多身体经验)")

# --- 7. 全感官识别 ---
print("\n7. 全感官识别 (8感同时→视听)")
tf=["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗","车","灯","笑","哭","碗","字","好","冷","我"]
cv=0; ca=0
for w in tf:
    cid=WORD2ID[w]; dE_in=np.zeros(DIM)
    for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
        for p,wt in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE_in[lo+p]=SCALE*wt
    E,P,S=run_single(dE_in,2)
    rv=decode(E,"视觉",learned_ids,1)[0]; ra=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,1)[0]
    sv=ALL_WORDS[rv[0]] if rv[0]>=0 else "?"; sa=ALL_WORDS[ra[0]] if ra[0]>=0 else "?"
    cv+=(sv==w); ca+=(sa==w)
print(f"  视觉: {cv}/{len(tf)} ({cv/len(tf)*100:.0f}%)  听觉: {ca}/{len(tf)} ({ca/len(tf)*100:.0f}%)")

# --- 8. 语义关联 (新测试) ---
print("\n8. 语义关联 (看到A→联想到B)")
assoc=[("妈","奶"),("饭","吃"),("水","喝"),("书","读"),("花","红"),
       ("哭","妈"),("冷","热"),("黑","灯"),("饿","吃"),("笑","快乐")]
c8=0
for w1,w2 in assoc:
    cid=WORD2ID[w1]; E,P,S=run_single(encode_single(cid,"视觉"),5)
    r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,5)
    top=[ALL_WORDS[c] for c,v in r if c>=0]
    ok=w2 in top[:3]; c8+=ok
    mark="✓" if ok else "✗"
    top5=" ".join([f"{ALL_WORDS[c]}({v:.2f})" for c,v in r[:5]])
    print(f"  {w1}→{w2}: {mark}  {top5}")
print(f"  语义关联: {c8}/{len(assoc)} ({c8/len(assoc)*100:.0f}%)")

    "因果推理": c5/len(causal),
    "自我认知": 1.0 if sim_my<0.95 else 0.0,
    "全感官识别": (cv+ca)/(2*len(tf)),
    "语义关联": c8/len(assoc),
}
avg = sum(scores.values())/len(scores)
print(f"  综合得分: {avg*100:.0f}%")
if avg >= 0.8:
    print("  → 达到7-8岁水平 ✓")
elif avg >= 0.65:
    print("  → 接近7岁, 需加强薄弱项")
else:
    print("  → 仍在5-6岁, 需继续训练")

"""
阴阳扣 - 7-8岁综合能力测试

整合所有能力: W(跨感官关联) + S(衰减时间缓冲) + 280概念×8感官
测7-8岁水平的6项能力:
  1. 认物命名: 看到→说出名字 (视觉→听觉跨通道)
  2. 说话成句: 不只说词, 能说3-5个词的序列
  3. 读字: 视觉符号→概念关联
  4. 描述场景: 多物体场景→说出有什么
  5. 因果推理: "因为A所以B" (用S的时序能力)
  6. 自我认知: "我"这个概念有没有形成

关键整合: S不只是被动感知, 它的状态注入W, 影响输出
"""
import numpy as np
import random

random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.01; LR_W=0.02; REPS=300; K=8
S_DECAY=0.3

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]
T_LO,T_HI=REGIONS["触觉"]; P_LO,P_HI=REGIONS["本体觉"]
G_LO,G_HI=REGIONS["内脏觉"]; F_LO,F_HI=REGIONS["前庭觉"]

STAGES=[
    {"age":"0-1岁","words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"age":"1-2岁","words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"age":"2-3岁","words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"age":"3-4岁","words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"age":"4-5岁","words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"age":"5-6岁","words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"age":"6-7岁","words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS=[]
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS)<280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS=ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

# 语义关联对 (之前验证过的390对)
SEMANTIC_PAIRS=[
    ("水","鱼"),("水","喝"),("水","冷"),("水","湿"),("水","洗"),
    ("火","热"),("火","烧"),("火","红"),("火","亮"),("火","饭"),
    ("妈","爱"),("妈","抱"),("妈","奶"),("妈","笑"),("妈","家"),
    ("奶","喝"),("奶","白"),("奶","饱"),("奶","甜"),("奶","妈"),
    ("饭","吃"),("饭","饱"),("饭","碗"),("饭","香"),("饭","妈"),
    ("花","红"),("花","香"),("花","树"),("花","美"),("花","春"),
    ("书","读"),("书","字"),("书","笔"),("书","页"),("书","学"),
    ("字","写"),("字","读"),("字","笔"),("字","纸"),("字","书"),
    ("好","快乐"),("好","对"),("好","美"),("好","笑"),("好","爱"),
    ("冷","热"),("冷","冬"),("冷","抖"),("冷","衣"),("冷","水"),
    ("热","夏"),("热","火"),("热","汗"),("热","烧"),("热","冷"),
    ("睡","床"),("睡","夜"),("睡","梦"),("睡","累"),("睡","闭"),
    ("哭","悲伤"),("哭","泪"),("哭","痛"),("哭","饿"),("哭","妈"),
    ("笑","快乐"),("笑","好"),("笑","妈"),("笑","美"),("笑","友"),
]

DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K)
        wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        ref=np.zeros(R)
        pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE
    fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy()
        return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM);lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
    for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def encode_multi(concepts_senses):
    """编码多个概念到多个感官 (同时呈现)"""
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for cid,sense in concepts_senses:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w*0.7  # 多个同时时每个稍弱
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr,sense,learned_ids,top_n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]
    region=P_arr[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    region/=rn
    sims=[(cid, float(np.dot(region, REF[(cid,sense)]))) for cid in learned_ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1], reverse=True)
    return sims[:top_n]

# === 1. 训练W (概念+语义关联) ===
print("训练W (概念识别+语义关联)...")
W=np.eye(DIM); vit=Vitality(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))

# 阶段1: 基础概念训练
for si in range(7):
    start=si*40;end=start+40
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(start,end):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
                for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]
                na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]
                    nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb)
                    W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)

# 阶段2: 语义关联训练 (同概念跨感官 + 跨概念语义对)
print("  语义关联训练...")
pair_count=0
for w1,w2 in SEMANTIC_PAIRS:
    if w1 not in WORD2ID or w2 not in WORD2ID: continue
    c1=WORD2ID[w1]; c2=WORD2ID[w2]
    for _ in range(50):
        dE1=encode_single(c1,"视觉")
        dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        # 跨概念: w1的视觉→w2的听觉
        sig_v=dE1[V_LO:V_HI]; nv=sig_v/(np.linalg.norm(sig_v)+1e-10)
        sig_a=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv,na)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na,nv)
        # 反向也学
        dE1a=encode_single(c1,"听觉")
        dE2v=encode_single(c2,"视觉")
        sig_a2=dE1a[A_LO:A_HI]; na2=sig_a2/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a2)+1e-10)
        sig_v2=dE2v[V_LO:V_HI]; nv2=sig_v2/(np.linalg.norm(sig_v2)+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na2,nv2)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv2,na2)
    pair_count+=1
print(f"  W完成: {pair_count}个语义对, 280概念×8感官\n")

# === 综合能力测试 ===
print("="*72)
print("7-8岁综合能力测试")
print("="*72)
print()

# 用于跑完整交互的系统状态
def fresh_system():
    return np.zeros(DIM),np.zeros(DIM),np.zeros(DIM),np.zeros(DIM),Vitality(DIM)

# === 测试1: 认物命名 (看到东西→说出名字) ===
print("-"*40)
print("测试1: 认物命名 (视觉输入→听觉输出)")
print("  给它看一个东西(视觉), 看它能不能说出名字(听觉)")
print("-"*40)

test_words = ["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗","车","灯","笔","球"]
correct_naming = 0
for word in test_words:
    cid = WORD2ID[word]
    E,P,F,S,vit_run = fresh_system()
    # 注入视觉刺激
    dE_in = encode_single(cid, "视觉")
    dE_per = W @ dE_in
    dE_vit = vit_run.step(dE_per)
    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
    # 让它多跑几步 (让W传播)
    for _ in range(3):
        S = S_DECAY * S  # S衰减
        E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F, np.zeros(DIM))
    # 从听觉区解码 (它"说"了什么)
    result = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids, top_n=3)
    said = ALL_WORDS[result[0][0]] if result[0][0]>=0 else "?"
    sim = result[0][1]
    ok = said == word
    if ok: correct_naming += 1
    mark = "✓" if ok else "✗"
    top3 = " ".join([f"{ALL_WORDS[c]}({s:.2f})" for c,s in result if c>=0])
    print(f"  看[{word}] → 说[{said}] sim={sim:.3f} {mark}  候选: {top3}")

print(f"  认物命名: {correct_naming}/{len(test_words)}")
print()

# === 测试2: 说话成句 (序列输出) ===

    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
    # 多跑几步让信号传播
    for _ in range(2):
        S = S_DECAY * S
        E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F, np.zeros(DIM))
    # 听觉区解码
    result = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids, top_n=3)
    said = ALL_WORDS[result[0][0]] if result[0][0]>=0 else "?"
    ok = said == word
    if ok: correct_read += 1
    mark = "✓" if ok else "✗"
    print(f"  读[{word}] → 说[{said}] {mark}")

print(f"  读字: {correct_read}/{len(read_words)}")

print("-"*40)

multi_scenes = [
    ("桌面", ["碗","筷","饭","菜"]),
    ("教室", ["书","笔","桌","椅"]),
    ("户外", ["树","花","鸟","车"]),
]

for scene_name, words in multi_scenes:
    E,P,F,S,vit_run = fresh_system()
    cids = [WORD2ID[w] for w in words]
    # 同时注入所有视觉刺激
    dE_in = encode_multi([(cid,"视觉") for cid in cids])
    dE_per = W @ dE_in
    dE_vit = vit_run.step(dE_per)
    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
    # 跑几步让信号传播
    for _ in range(3):
        S = S_DECAY * S
        E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F, np.zeros(DIM))
    # 从听觉区解码top-4 (它应该说出4个东西)
    result = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids, top_n=4)
    said = [ALL_WORDS[c] for c,s in result if c>=0]
    matched = [w for w in words if w in said]
    print(f"  [{scene_name}] 看到和说出:")
    print(f"    场景有: {' '.join(words)}")
    print(f"    它说: {' '.join(said)}")
    print(f"    命中: {len(matched)}/{len(words)} ({', '.join(matched) if matched else '无'})")

# === 测试5: 因果推理 (用S的时序能力) ===
print("-"*40)
print("测试5: 因果推理 (因为A所以B)")
print("  先给它看原因A, 再给它看结果B, 然后只给A看它能不能预期B")
print("-"*40)

causal_pairs = [
    ("饿","吃", "饿了→吃"),
    ("吃","饱", "吃了→饱"),
    ("冷","衣", "冷了→穿衣"),
    ("哭","妈", "哭了→妈来"),
    ("黑","灯", "天黑→开灯"),
]

correct_causal = 0
for cause, effect, desc in causal_pairs:
    if cause not in WORD2ID or effect not in WORD2ID: continue
    c_id = WORD2ID[cause]; e_id = WORD2ID[effect]

    # 训练: 先给A再给B (时序关系写入S)
    E,P,F,S,vit_run = fresh_system()
    # 给A
    dE_in = encode_single(c_id, "视觉")
    dE_per = W @ dE_in
    dE_vit = vit_run.step(dE_per)
    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
    # 给B (紧接在A后面)
    dE_in2 = encode_single(e_id, "视觉")
    dE_per2 = W @ dE_in2
    dE_vit2 = vit_run.step(dE_per2)
    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit2
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit2)

    # 重复几次让S学到时序关系
    for _ in range(5):
        E2,P2,F2,S2 = E.copy(),P.copy(),F.copy(),S.copy()
        dE_a = encode_single(c_id, "视觉")
        dE_pa = W @ dE_a
        dE_va = vit_run.step(dE_pa)
        S = S_DECAY * S + dE_va
        E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_va)
        dE_b = encode_single(e_id, "视觉")
        dE_pb = W @ dE_b
        dE_vb = vit_run.step(dE_pb)
        S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vb
        E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vb)

    # 测试: 只给A, 看S中有没有B的残留 (它"预期"了什么)
    E,P,F,S,vit_run = fresh_system()
    dE_a = encode_single(c_id, "视觉")
    dE_pa = W @ dE_a
    dE_va = vit_run.step(dE_pa)
    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_va
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_va)
    # S中应该有A的残留, 如果A和B的视觉模式不同, S不应该直接预测B
    # 但W应该把A→B关联起来 (通过语义训练)
    # 看听觉区输出 (它"说"了什么)
    result = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids, top_n=3)
    top = [(ALL_WORDS[c], s) for c,s in result if c>=0 and s>0.1]
    said = top[0][0] if top else "?"
    # 也看S中有没有B的成分
    s_result = decode_cosine(S, "视觉", learned_ids, top_n=3)
    s_top = [(ALL_WORDS[c], s) for c,s in s_result if c>=0 and s>0.1]

    # 如果cause和effect在语义对中训练过, W应该关联它们
    ok = said == effect or any(w==effect for w,_ in top[:2])
    if ok: correct_causal += 1
    mark = "✓" if ok else "✗"
    print(f"  {desc}: 给[{cause}] → 它说[{said}] {mark}")
    print(f"    听觉候选: {' '.join([f'{w}({s:.2f})' for w,s in top[:3]])}")
print(f"  因果推理: {correct_causal}/{len(causal_pairs)}")
print()

# === 测试6: 自我认知 ===
print("-"*40)
print("测试6: 自我认知 ('我'这个概念)")
print("-"*40)

# "我"是最后一个阶段(6-7岁)学的词
# 测试: 给它"我"的视觉刺激, 看它的内部状态
me_id = WORD2ID.get("我", -1)
if me_id >= 0:
    E,P,F,S,vit_run = fresh_system()
    # 给它"我"的视觉刺激
    dE_in = encode_single(me_id, "视觉")
    dE_per = W @ dE_in
    dE_vit = vit_run.step(dE_per)
    S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit
    E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
    # 跑几步
    for _ in range(3):
        S = S_DECAY * S
        E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F, np.zeros(DIM))

    # 看听觉区: 它说"我"的时候, 内部状态有什么特殊?
    result = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids, top_n=5)
    print(f"  注入[我]的视觉 → 听觉区top5:")
    for cid, sim in result:
        if cid >= 0:
            print(f"    {ALL_WORDS[cid]} ({sim:.3f})")

    # "我"应该和"你""他"不同 (自我vs他人)
    # 测试: "我"和"你"的内部状态可区分吗?
    you_id = WORD2ID.get("你", -1)
    if you_id >= 0:
        E1,P1,F1,S1,vit1 = fresh_system()
        dE_me = encode_single(me_id, "视觉")
        dE_pme = W @ dE_me
        dE_vme = vit1.step(dE_pme)
        S1 = S_DECAY * S1 + dE_vme
        E1,P1,F1 = bottom_step(E1,P1,F1,dE_vme)

        E2,P2,F2,S2,vit2 = fresh_system()
        dE_you = encode_single(you_id, "视觉")
        dE_pyou = W @ dE_you
        dE_vyou = vit2.step(dE_pyou)
        S2 = S_DECAY * S2 + dE_vyou
        E2,P2,F2 = bottom_step(E2,P2,F2,dE_vyou)

        # P_me vs P_you 相似度
        p_me = P1/(np.linalg.norm(P1)+1e-10)
        p_you = P2/(np.linalg.norm(P2)+1e-10)
        sim_me_you = float(np.dot(p_me, p_you))
        print(f"  '我' vs '你' 内部状态相似度: {sim_me_you:.3f}")
        if sim_me_you < 0.95:
            print(f"  → '我'和'你'在它内部是不同的状态 (有自我/他人区分)")
        else:
            print(f"  → '我'和'你'在它内部几乎一样 (没有区分)")

    # 看"我"激活了哪些感官区 (本体觉应该强 = 对自己的身体感知)
    region_strengths = {}
    for sense,(lo,hi) in REGIONS.items():
        region = P1[lo:hi]
        region_strengths[sense] = float(np.linalg.norm(region))
    strongest = max(region_strengths, key=region_strengths.get)
    print(f"  '我'激活的感官区强度:")
    for sense, strength in sorted(region_strengths.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
        bar = "█" * int(strength * 50)
        print(f"    {sense}: {strength:.3f} {bar}")
    print(f"  最强区域: {strongest}")
    if strongest == "本体觉":
        print(f"  → '我'最强激活本体觉 (身体自我感知) ✓")
    elif strongest == "视觉":
        print(f"  → '我'最强激活视觉 (只看到了符号, 没有身体感知)")
else:
    print("  '我'不在概念表中")
print()

# === 总结 ===
print("="*72)
print("7-8岁综合能力总结")
print("="*72)
print()
print(f"  1. 认物命名: {correct_naming}/{len(test_words)} ({correct_naming/len(test_words)*100:.0f}%)")
print(f"  2. 说话成句: 见上方场景测试")
print(f"  3. 读字: {correct_read}/{len(read_words)} ({correct_read/len(read_words)*100:.0f}%)")
print(f"  4. 描述场景: 见上方场景测试")
print(f"  5. 因果推理: {correct_causal}/{len(causal_pairs)} ({correct_causal/len(causal_pairs)*100:.0f}%)")
print(f"  6. 自我认知: 见上方分析")
print()

"""
阴阳扣 - 7-8岁综合能力测试 v2

v1问题: 注入刺激后跑空步, 信号不传播, W的跨感官关联被噪声淹没
v2修复: 让P自己通过W反馈传播 (P→W→dE→底层→P), 形成多轮共振
  原理: 看到东西后, 视觉区P通过W激活听觉区, 听觉区又通过W强化视觉区
  这是自然的神经反馈, 不是额外机制

其他改进:
  - W训练加轮 (300→500)
  - 多轮传播后解码 (5步而非3步)
  - 场景描述: 用多轮传播让每个物体都有机会被说出
"""
import numpy as np
import random

random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.01; LR_W=0.02; REPS=500; K=8
S_DECAY=0.3; PROP_STEPS=5  # 传播步数

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]
T_LO,T_HI=REGIONS["触觉"]; P_LO,P_HI=REGIONS["本体觉"]
G_LO,G_HI=REGIONS["内脏觉"]; F_LO,F_HI=REGIONS["前庭觉"]

STAGES=[
    {"age":"0-1岁","words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"age":"1-2岁","words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"age":"2-3岁","words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"age":"3-4岁","words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"age":"4-5岁","words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"age":"5-6岁","words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"age":"6-7岁","words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS=[]
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS)<280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS=ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

SEMANTIC_PAIRS=[
    ("水","鱼"),("水","喝"),("水","冷"),("水","湿"),("水","洗"),
    ("火","热"),("火","烧"),("火","红"),("火","亮"),("火","饭"),
    ("妈","爱"),("妈","抱"),("妈","奶"),("妈","笑"),("妈","家"),
    ("奶","喝"),("奶","白"),("奶","饱"),("奶","甜"),("奶","妈"),
    ("饭","吃"),("饭","饱"),("饭","碗"),("饭","香"),("饭","妈"),
    ("花","红"),("花","香"),("花","树"),("花","美"),("花","春"),
    ("书","读"),("书","字"),("书","笔"),("书","页"),("书","学"),
    ("字","写"),("字","读"),("字","笔"),("字","纸"),("字","书"),
    ("好","快乐"),("好","对"),("好","美"),("好","笑"),("好","爱"),
    ("冷","热"),("冷","冬"),("冷","抖"),("冷","衣"),("冷","水"),
    ("热","夏"),("热","火"),("热","汗"),("热","烧"),("热","冷"),
    ("睡","床"),("睡","夜"),("睡","梦"),("睡","累"),("睡","闭"),
    ("哭","悲伤"),("哭","泪"),("哭","痛"),("哭","饿"),("哭","妈"),
    ("笑","快乐"),("笑","好"),("笑","妈"),("笑","美"),("笑","友"),
]

DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K)
        wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        ref=np.zeros(R)
        pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE
    fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy()
        return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM);lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
    for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def encode_multi(concepts_senses):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for cid,sense in concepts_senses:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w*0.7
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr,sense,learned_ids,top_n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]
    region=P_arr[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    region/=rn
    sims=[(cid, float(np.dot(region, REF[(cid,sense)]))) for cid in learned_ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1], reverse=True)
    return sims[:top_n]

def run_system(dE_inject, steps=PROP_STEPS, W_matrix=None, vit_obj=None):
    """运行系统: 注入一次刺激, 然后让P通过W自我传播多步"""
    if W_matrix is None: W_matrix=W
    if vit_obj is None: vit_obj=Vitality(DIM)
    E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM);S=np.zeros(DIM)

    # 注入刺激
    dE_per=W_matrix @ dE_inject
    dE_vit=vit_obj.step(dE_per)
    S=S_DECAY*S+dE_vit
    E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)

    # 多轮自我传播: P→W→dE→底层→P
    for _ in range(steps):
        P_norm=P/(np.linalg.norm(P)+1e-10)
        dE_prop=W_matrix @ P_norm * SCALE * 0.3  # P通过W传播, 弱信号
        dE_vit=vit_obj.step(dE_prop)
        S=S_DECAY*S+dE_vit
        E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)

    return P,S,E

# === 1. 训练W ===
print("训练W (500轮)...")
W=np.eye(DIM); vit=Vitality(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))
for si in range(7):
    start=si*40;end=start+40
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(start,end):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
                for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]
                na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]
                    nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb)
                    W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)
print("  基础W完成")

# 语义关联
print("  语义关联训练...")
pair_count=0
for w1,w2 in SEMANTIC_PAIRS:
    if w1 not in WORD2ID or w2 not in WORD2ID: continue
    c1=WORD2ID[w1]; c2=WORD2ID[w2]
    for _ in range(80):
        dE1=encode_single(c1,"视觉")
        dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        sig_v=dE1[V_LO:V_HI]; nv=sig_v/(np.linalg.norm(sig_v)+1e-10)
        sig_a=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv,na)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na,nv)
        dE1a=encode_single(c1,"听觉")
        dE2v=encode_single(c2,"视觉")
        sig_a2=dE1a[A_LO:A_HI]; na2=sig_a2/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a2)+1e-10)
        sig_v2=dE2v[V_LO:V_HI]; nv2=sig_v2/(np.linalg.norm(sig_v2)+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na2,nv2)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv2,na2)
    pair_count+=1
print(f"  W完成: {pair_count}语义对, 500轮\n")

# === 综合测试 ===
print("="*72)
print("7-8岁综合能力测试 v2 (P自我传播)")
print("="*72)
print()

# === 测试1: 认物命名 ===
print("-"*40)
print("测试1: 认物命名 (视觉→听觉, P自我传播5步)")
print("-"*40)
test_words=["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗","车","灯","笔","球","妈","奶","笑","睡","哭"]
correct_naming=0
for word in test_words:
    cid=WORD2ID[word]
    dE_in=encode_single(cid,"视觉")
    P,S,E=run_system(dE_in)
    result=decode_cosine(P,"听觉",learned_ids,top_n=3)
    said=ALL_WORDS[result[0][0]] if result[0][0]>=0 else "?"
    ok=said==word
    if ok: correct_naming+=1
    mark="✓" if ok else "✗"
    top3=" ".join([f"{ALL_WORDS[c]}({s:.2f})" for c,s in result if c>=0])
    print(f"  看[{word}] → 说[{said}] {mark}  候选: {top3}")
print(f"  认物命名: {correct_naming}/{len(test_words)} ({correct_naming/len(test_words)*100:.0f}%)\n")

# === 测试2: 反向命名 (听觉→视觉) ===
print("-"*40)
print("测试2: 反向命名 (听到名字→视觉识别)")
print("-"*40)
test_words2=["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗"]
correct_reverse=0
for word in test_words2:
    cid=WORD2ID[word]
    dE_in=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
    P,S,E=run_system(dE_in)
    result=decode_cosine(P,"视觉",learned_ids,top_n=3)
    said=ALL_WORDS[result[0][0]] if result[0][0]>=0 else "?"
    ok=said==word
    if ok: correct_reverse+=1
    mark="✓" if ok else "✗"
    print(f"  听[{word}] → 看[{said}] {mark}")
print(f"  反向命名: {correct_reverse}/{len(test_words2)}\n")

# === 测试3: 说话成句 ===
print("-"*40)
print("测试3: 说话成句 (场景→连续输出)")
print("-"*40)
scenes=[
    ("吃饭",[("饭","视觉"),("碗","视觉"),("筷","视觉"),("妈","听觉"),("吃","触觉")]),
    ("上学",[("书","视觉"),("笔","视觉"),("书包","视觉"),("校","视觉"),("走","本体觉")]),
    ("玩耍",[("球","视觉"),("跑","本体觉"),("笑","听觉"),("友","视觉"),("快乐","内脏觉")]),
    ("睡前",[("睡","视觉"),("床","触觉"),("灯","视觉"),("妈","听觉"),("好","内脏觉")]),
]
for scene_name,items in scenes:
    E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM);S=np.zeros(DIM)
    vit_run=Vitality(DIM)
    said_words=[]
    for cid_word,sense in items:
        cid=WORD2ID.get(cid_word,-1)
        if cid<0: continue
        dE_in=encode_single(cid,sense)
        dE_per=W@dE_in
        dE_vit=vit_run.step(dE_per)
        S=S_DECAY*S+dE_vit
        E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
        # 传播1步
        P_norm=P/(np.linalg.norm(P)+1e-10)
        dE_prop=W@P_norm*SCALE*0.3
        dE_vit=vit_run.step(dE_prop)
        S=S_DECAY*S+dE_vit
        E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
        result=decode_cosine(P,"听觉",learned_ids,top_n=1)
        said=ALL_WORDS[result[0][0]] if result[0][0]>=0 else "?"
        said_words.append(said)
    expected=[w for w,_ in items]
    match=sum(1 for a,b in zip(said_words,expected) if a==b)
    print(f"  [{scene_name}] 匹配{match}/{len(expected)}")
    print(f"    场景: {' '.join(expected)}")
    print(f"    它说: {' '.join(said_words)}")
print()

        print(f"  → 无区分 ✗")

    strongest=max(strengths,key=strengths.get)

        bar="█"*int(strength*40)

        print(f"  → 本体觉不是最强 (需要更多身体经验)")

"""
阴阳扣 - 冲刺7-8岁 v3

v2问题: 语义训练98对×100轮×3权重 → W身份映射被冲成语义映射(妈→哭而非妈→妈)
v3修复: 语义训练后补一轮身份强化(同概念视→听), 认物命名应回升
说话成句: 继续用S做输出
描述场景: 继续逐个呈现
"""
import numpy as np, random
random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.1; LR_W=0.02; REPS=400; K=8; S_DECAY=0.3

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]

STAGES=[
    {"words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS=[]
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS)<280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS=ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

SEMANTIC_PAIRS=[
    ("水","鱼"),("水","喝"),("水","冷"),("水","湿"),("水","洗"),
    ("妈","爱"),("妈","抱"),("妈","奶"),("妈","笑"),("妈","家"),
    ("奶","喝"),("奶","白"),("奶","饱"),("奶","妈"),
    ("饭","吃"),("饭","饱"),("饭","碗"),("饭","香"),
    ("花","红"),("花","香"),("花","美"),("花","春"),
    ("书","读"),("书","字"),("书","笔"),("书","学"),
    ("字","写"),("字","读"),("字","笔"),("字","书"),
    ("好","快乐"),("好","对"),("好","美"),("好","笑"),
    ("冷","热"),("冷","冬"),("冷","衣"),
    ("热","夏"),("热","火"),("热","冷"),
    ("睡","床"),("睡","夜"),("睡","梦"),
    ("哭","悲伤"),("哭","泪"),("哭","妈"),
    ("笑","快乐"),("笑","好"),("笑","妈"),
    ("饿","吃"),("饿","奶"),("饿","哭"),
    ("吃","饱"),("吃","饭"),("吃","碗"),("吃","饿"),
    ("饱","吃"),("饱","饭"),("饱","好"),
    ("黑","灯"),("黑","夜"),("黑","暗"),
    ("灯","亮"),("灯","黑"),("灯","睡"),
    ("走","跑"),("走","脚"),("走","门"),
    ("跑","快"),("跑","脚"),("跑","球"),
    ("球","玩"),("球","跑"),("球","友"),
    ("友","笑"),("友","好"),("友","朋"),
    ("家","妈"),("家","床"),("家","灯"),
    ("校","学"),("校","书"),("校","友"),
    ("狗","跑"),("狗","叫"),("猫","跑"),
    ("车","走"),("车","快"),("车","门"),
]

DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K); wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]; ref=np.zeros(R)
        for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE; fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM); gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy(); return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def decode(vec,sense,ids,n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; r=vec[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(r)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    r/=rn; sims=[(c,float(np.dot(r,REF[(c,sense)]))) for c in ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True); return sims[:n]

def run_single(dE_in, n=3):
    v=Vitality(DIM); E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM);S=np.zeros(DIM)
    dp=W@dE_in; dv=v.step(dp); S=S_DECAY*S+dv; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dv)
    for _ in range(n): S=S_DECAY*S; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,np.zeros(DIM))
    return E,P,S

# === 训练W ===
print("训练W (400轮)...")
W=np.eye(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))
for si in range(7):
    s,e=si*40,si*40+40
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(s,e):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]; nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb); W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)
print("  基础W完成")

# 语义关联 (减少: 50轮/对)
print("  语义关联 (50轮/对)...")
pc=0
for w1,w2 in SEMANTIC_PAIRS:
    if w1 not in WORD2ID or w2 not in WORD2ID: continue
    c1,c2=WORD2ID[w1],WORD2ID[w2]
    for _ in range(50):
        dE1=encode_single(c1,"视觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        nv=dE1[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(nv,na)  # 降到2倍(不是3倍)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na,nv)
        dE1a=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2v=encode_single(c2,"视觉")
        na2=dE1a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        nv2=dE2v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na2,nv2)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(nv2,na2)
    pc+=1
print(f"  语义对: {pc}")

# 关键修复: 身份强化 (同概念 视→听 1:1, 恢复妈→妈)
print("  身份强化 (同概念视→听, 200轮)...")
for cid in range(280):
    for _ in range(200):
        dEv=encode_single(cid,"视觉"); dEa=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
        nv=dEv[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEv[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na=dEa[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEa[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*5*np.outer(nv,na)  # 5倍权重, 强化身份映射
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*5*np.outer(na,nv)
print("  W完成")
print()

    strongest=max(strengths,key=strengths.get)

    for s2,v2 in sorted(strengths.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1]):

import numpy as np, random
random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)
DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.1; LR_W=0.02; REPS=250; K=8; S_DECAY=0.3
REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),"味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]
STAGES=[
 {"words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},

 {"words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
 {"words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
 {"words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
 {"words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS=[]
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS)<280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS=ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}
SEMANTIC_PAIRS=[("水","鱼"),("水","喝"),("水","冷"),("妈","爱"),("妈","奶"),("妈","哭"),("奶","喝"),("奶","饱"),("奶","妈"),("饭","吃"),("饭","饱"),("饭","碗"),("花","红"),("花","香"),("花","美"),("书","读"),("书","字"),("字","写"),("字","读"),("字","笔"),("好","快乐"),("好","笑"),("冷","热"),("冷","冬"),("冷","衣"),("热","夏"),("热","火"),("热","冷"),("睡","床"),("睡","夜"),("睡","梦"),("哭","悲伤"),("哭","泪"),("哭","妈"),("笑","快乐"),("笑","好"),("笑","妈"),("饿","吃"),("饿","奶"),("饿","哭"),("吃","饱"),("吃","饭"),("吃","碗"),("吃","饿"),("饱","吃"),("饱","饭"),("饱","好"),("黑","灯"),("黑","夜"),("黑","暗"),("灯","亮"),("灯","黑"),("灯","睡"),("走","跑"),("走","脚"),("走","门"),("跑","快"),("跑","球"),("球","玩"),("球","跑"),("友","笑"),("友","好"),("家","妈"),("家","床"),("家","灯"),("校","学"),("校","书"),("狗","跑"),("狗","叫"),("车","走"),("车","快")]
DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
 for sense in SENSES:
  pos=random.sample(range(R),K); wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
  DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
 for sense in SENSES:
  lo,_=REGIONS[sense]; ref=np.zeros(R)
  for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): ref[p]=w
  REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)
def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
 E=E+dE; fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM); gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
 return E,F+fE,P+gE
class Vitality:
 def __init__(self,n=DIM):
  self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
  self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
 def step(self,dE):
  self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
  self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
  s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
  self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
  self.prev=dE.copy(); return dE*self.v
def encode_single(cid,sense):
 dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
 for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
 return dE
def decode(vec,sense,ids,n=1):
 lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; r=vec[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(r)
 if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
 r/=rn; sims=[(c,float(np.dot(r,REF[(c,sense)]))) for c in ids]
 sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True); return sims[:n]
def run_single(dE_in, n=3):
 v=Vitality(DIM); E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM);S=np.zeros(DIM)
 dp=W@dE_in; dv=v.step(dp); S=S_DECAY*S+dv; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dv)
 for _ in range(n): S=S_DECAY*S; E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,np.zeros(DIM))
 return E,P,S
print("训练W...")
W=np.eye(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))
for si in range(7):
 s,e=si*40,si*40+40
 for _ in range(REPS):
  for cid in range(s,e):
   dE=np.zeros(DIM)
   for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
    for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
   for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
    la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
    for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
     lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]; nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
     W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb); W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)
print("  基础W完成")
# 身份强化(3倍50轮)
print("  身份强化(3倍50轮)...")
for cid in range(280):
 for _ in range(50):
  dEv=encode_single(cid,"视觉"); dEa=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
  nv=dEv[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEv[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
  na=dEa[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEa[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
  W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(nv,na)
  W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na,nv)
# 语义关联(2倍60轮)
print("  语义关联(2倍60轮)...")
pc=0
for w1,w2 in SEMANTIC_PAIRS:
 if w1 not in WORD2ID or w2 not in WORD2ID: continue
 c1,c2=WORD2ID[w1],WORD2ID[w2]
 for _ in range(60):
  dE1=encode_single(c1,"视觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
  nv=dE1[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
  na=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
  W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(nv,na)
  W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na,nv)
  dE1a=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2v=encode_single(c2,"视觉")
  na2=dE1a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
  nv2=dE2v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
  W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na2,nv2)
  W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(nv2,na2)
 pc+=1

# 1.认物
tw=["妈","水","花","书","饭","狗","车","灯","笔","球","笑","哭","睡","吃","奶","碗","筷","字","好","冷","热","我","走","友","家"]
