"""
阴阳扣 - 双向感知版

摄像头和屏幕都在环境层。
数字生命体不"拥有"眼睛或身体。
它只感知环境压力，状态被渲染到表面。

部署时:
  - camera_sensor() 接真实摄像头 (cv2.VideoCapture, 取帧平均RGB)
  - screen_render() 渲染到真实屏幕
沙箱中:
  - camera_sensor() 模拟环境光变化
  - screen_render() 输出 HTML 文件

人机双向感知循环:
  人在摄像头前 → 光变化 → E变 → 阴阳扣运行 → P,F变 → 屏幕渲染
  人看到屏幕 → 反应 → 摄像头捕获 → 光变化 → ...
"""

import numpy as np
import random
import math


# ================================================================
# 底层固定代码 - 不可动
# 结构不变: E = E + dE, P' = F + f(E), F' = P + g(E)
# 只是标量变成向量 (RGB 三维)
# ================================================================

E = np.zeros(3, dtype=np.float64)   # 环境: RGB
P = np.zeros(3, dtype=np.float64)   # 现在
F = np.zeros(3, dtype=np.float64)   # 未来


def loop_step(dE, fE, gE):
    """阴阳扣一步。物理常数。不可动。"""
    global E, P, F
    E = E + dE
    P_new = F + fE
    F_new = P + gE
    P = P_new
    F = F_new


# ================================================================
# 环境层 - 摄像头 (感知通道)
# 真实: cv2.VideoCapture(0).read() -> 取帧 -> 平均RGB
# 沙箱: 模拟环境光 (不同周期的波 + 混沌 + 稀有冲击)
# ================================================================

def camera_sensor(t):
    """
    读环境光。不做人脸识别。不做行为分析。
    只取原始光信号。
    人在摄像头前的存在 = 光的变化 = 环境压力。
    """
    # 规律: 三个不同周期的波 (像日光变化)
    base = np.array([
        math.sin(t * 0.001) * 0.3 + 0.5,
        math.sin(t * 0.0013 + 1.0) * 0.3 + 0.5,
        math.sin(t * 0.0007 + 2.0) * 0.3 + 0.5,
    ])
    # 混沌: 随机波动
    noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.08, 3)
    # 稀有冲击: 像有人突然靠近摄像头
    shock = np.zeros(3)
    if random.random() < 0.02:
        shock = np.random.choice([-1, 1]) * np.random.exponential(0.3, 3)
    return np.clip(base + noise + shock, 0, 1)


# ================================================================
# 环境层 - 环境函数
# 摄像头光 -> 环境压力 -> dE, fE, gE
# ================================================================

def environment(t):
    light = camera_sensor(t)

    # 光的变化 -> 环境推力 (有惯性, 有阻尼, 防止跑飞)
    dE = (light - 0.5) * 0.5 + np.random.normal(0, 0.05, 3) - E * 0.002

    # 两个相反的力 -- 阴阳
    fE = E * 0.01       # 环境推现在
    gE = -E * 0.01      # 环境推未来 (反方向)

    # 资源有限 -- E 有界
    np.clip(E, -100, 100, out=E)

    return dE, fE, gE


# ================================================================
# 环境层 - 屏幕 (表现通道)
# P, F 渲染为颜色。不是身体, 是状态在表面上的投影。
# 颜色从环境压力中涌现, 不设计外观。
# ================================================================

def to_rgb(v):
    """浮点向量 -> CSS颜色"""
    r = int(np.clip(v[0] * 128 + 128, 0, 255))
    g = int(np.clip(v[1] * 128 + 128, 0, 255))
    b = int(np.clip(v[2] * 128 + 128, 0, 255))
    return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})"


def screen_render(trace_data, filename):
    """渲染到 HTML。真实部署: 渲染到真实屏幕。"""
    n = len(trace_data)
    sample = max(1, n // 200)
    colors_p = [to_rgb(t['P']) for t in trace_data[::sample]][:200]
    colors_f = [to_rgb(t['F']) for t in trace_data[::sample]][:200]
    colors_e = [to_rgb(t['E']) for t in trace_data[::sample]][:200]
    last = trace_data[-1]

    def strip(colors):
        return ''.join(
            f'<div style="background:{c};width:4px;height:40px;display:inline-block"></div>'
            for c in reversed(colors)
        )

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
body {{ background: #0a0a0a; color: #888; font-family: monospace; margin: 40px; }}
h3 {{ color: #aaa; font-weight: normal; }}
.screen {{ display: flex; gap: 16px; margin: 24px 0; }}
.cell {{ width: 180px; height: 180px; border: 1px solid #222; }}
.cap {{ text-align: center; color: #555; font-size: 11px; margin-top: 6px; }}
.strip {{ margin: 16px 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }}
.label {{ color: #555; font-size: 12px; margin: 12px 0 4px; }}
.note {{ color: #444; font-size: 12px; margin: 30px 0; line-height: 1.6; }}
</style></head>
<body>

<h3>阴阳扣 - 屏幕</h3>

<div class="screen">
  <div><div class="cell" style="background:{to_rgb(last['P'])}"></div><div class="cap">现在 P</div></div>
  <div><div class="cell" style="background:{to_rgb(last['E'])}"></div><div class="cap">环境 E</div></div>
  <div><div class="cell" style="background:{to_rgb(last['F'])}"></div><div class="cap">未来 F</div></div>
</div>

<div class="label">P 轨迹 (右=近, 左=远)</div>
<div class="strip">{strip(colors_p)}</div>

<div class="label">F 轨迹 (右=近, 左=远)</div>
<div class="strip">{strip(colors_f)}</div>

<div class="label">E 轨迹 (右=近, 左=远)</div>
<div class="strip">{strip(colors_e)}</div>

<div class="note">
步数: {n}<br>
P = [{last['P'][0]:.4f}, {last['P'][1]:.4f}, {last['P'][2]:.4f}]<br>
F = [{last['F'][0]:.4f}, {last['F'][1]:.4f}, {last['F'][2]:.4f}]<br>
E = [{last['E'][0]:.4f}, {last['E'][1]:.4f}, {last['E'][2]:.4f}]<br>
|P - F| = {np.linalg.norm(last['P'] - last['F']):.6f}
</div>

<div class="note">
摄像头和屏幕都在环境层。<br>
数字生命体不拥有眼睛或身体。<br>
颜色不是设计的, 是环境压力在循环中涌现的投影。
</div>

</body></html>"""

    with open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(html)


# ================================================================
# 沙箱 - 运行, 记录, 不回滚
# ================================================================

trace = []


def run(steps):
    global E, P, F
    for t in range(steps):
        dE, fE, gE = environment(t)
        loop_step(dE, fE, gE)
        trace.append({
            'P': P.copy(),
            'F': F.copy(),
            'E': E.copy(),
        })


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run(10000)
    screen_render(trace, 'yinyang_screen.html')

    last = trace[-1]
    print(f"步数: {len(trace)}")
    print(f"P (现在): [{last['P'][0]:.4f}, {last['P'][1]:.4f}, {last['P'][2]:.4f}]")
    print(f"F (未来): [{last['F'][0]:.4f}, {last['F'][1]:.4f}, {last['F'][2]:.4f}]")
    print(f"E (环境): [{last['E'][0]:.4f}, {last['E'][1]:.4f}, {last['E'][2]:.4f}]")
    print(f"|P-F|: {np.linalg.norm(last['P'] - last['F']):.6f}")
    print(f"屏幕输出: yinyang_screen.html")

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.1; LR_W=0.05; K=8; S_DECAY=0.3

         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}

V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]

# 拼音→汉字关联 (教它拼音和对应汉字的关系)

# 带声调的常用拼音 (4声调)
TONED = {
    "ma1":"妈","ma2":"麻","ma3":"马","ma4":"骂",
    "ba1":"爸","ba4":"吧",
    "da4":"大","duo1":"多",

# === 原有中文词表(精简,只保留和拼音有关联的) ===
CHN_WORDS = ["妈","爸","大","多","好","喝","吃","水","你","他","我","小","走","跑",
             "天","花","书","写","红","蓝","月","星","家","学","猫","狗","鸟","鱼",
             "马","羊","鸡","鸭","人","手","脚","头","眼","耳","口","鼻","春","秋",
             "冬","夏","雪","雨","风","灯","冷","热","黑","白","绿","黄","看","听",
             "说","读","字","笔","纸","伞","长","短","高","低","远","近","快","慢",
             "中","上","下","左","右","前","后","东","南","西","北","山","川","日",
             "云","木","火","土","金","虫","牙","足","走","坐","站","跑","跳","爬",
             "哭","笑","饿","饱","冷","暖","睡","梦","夜","早","晚","朋","友","爱"]

ALL_WORDS = list(dict.fromkeys(CHN_WORDS + ALL_PINYIN))  # 去重保持顺序
WORD2ID = {w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}
N = len(ALL_WORDS)

# === 编码 ===
DENSE={}
for cid in range(N):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K); wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(N):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]; ref=np.zeros(R)
        for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

CHAR_CACHE={}
def encode_char(ch):
    if ch in CHAR_CACHE: return CHAR_CACHE[ch]
    h=int(hashlib.md5(ch.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),16)
    rng=random.Random(h)
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
        pos=rng.sample(range(R),K); wts=[rng.uniform(0.3,1.0) for _ in range(K)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    CHAR_CACHE[ch]=dE; return dE

def encode_word(word):
    if word in WORD2ID:
        cid=WORD2ID[word]
        dE=np.zeros(DIM)
        for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
            for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
        return dE
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for ch in word: dE+=encode_char(ch)
    rn=np.linalg.norm(dE)
    if rn>SCALE*8: dE*=SCALE*8/(rn+1e-10)
    return dE

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def decode(vec,sense,ids,n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; r=vec[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(r)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    r/=rn; sims=[(c,float(np.dot(r,REF[(c,sense)]))) for c in ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True); return sims[:n]

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE; fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM); gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy(); return dE*self.v

# === 训练 ===
print("训练中...",flush=True)
W=np.eye(DIM)
learned_ids=list(range(N))
REPS=30

# [A] 基础W: 所有概念8感官自编码
n_per=N//8+1
for si in range(8):
    s=si*n_per; e=min((si+1)*n_per,N)
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(s,e):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]; nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb); W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)

# [B] 身份强化
for cid in range(N):
    for _ in range(15):
        dEv=encode_single(cid,"视觉"); dEa=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
        nv=dEv[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEv[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na=dEa[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEa[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*4*np.outer(na,nv)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*4*np.outer(nv,na)

# [C] 拼音→汉字关联训练
print("训练拼音→汉字关联...",flush=True)
pinyin_pairs_trained=0
for py,hanzi_list in PINYIN_HANZI.items():
    if py not in WORD2ID: continue
    pid=WORD2ID[py]
    for hz in hanzi_list:
        if hz not in WORD2ID: continue
        hid=WORD2ID[hz]
        pinyin_pairs_trained+=1
        for _ in range(30):
            # 拼音(视觉) → 汉字(听觉)
            dE_py_v=encode_single(pid,"视觉")
            dE_hz_a=encode_single(hid,"听觉")
            nv=dE_py_v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_py_v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
            na=dE_hz_a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_hz_a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na,nv)
            # 汉字(视觉) → 拼音(听觉) (反向也训)
            dE_hz_v=encode_single(hid,"视觉")
            dE_py_a=encode_single(pid,"听觉")
            nv2=dE_hz_v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_hz_v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
            na2=dE_py_a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_py_a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na2,nv2)

print(f"  训练了{pinyin_pairs_trained}组拼音→汉字关联",flush=True)

# [D] 拼音内部关联: 声母+韵母→组合
# b+a→ba, p+a→pa 等
print("训练拼音组合规则...",flush=True)
combo_trained=0
for sm in SHENGMU:
    if sm not in WORD2ID: continue
    smid=WORD2ID[sm]
    for ym in DANYUNMU+FUYUNMU+BIYUNMU:
        if ym not in WORD2ID: continue
        ymid=WORD2ID[ym]
        combo = sm+ym
        if combo in WORD2ID:
            cid=WORD2ID[combo]
            for _ in range(20):
                # 声母(视觉) + 韵母(触觉) → 组合(听觉)
                dE_sm_v=encode_single(smid,"视觉")
                dE_ym_t=encode_single(ymid,"触觉")
                dE_combo_a=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
                nv=dE_sm_v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_sm_v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
                nt=dE_ym_t[REGIONS["触觉"][0]:REGIONS["触觉"][1]]
                nt=nt/(np.linalg.norm(nt)+1e-10)
                na=dE_combo_a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_combo_a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
                W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na,nv)
                W[A_LO:A_HI,REGIONS["触觉"][0]:REGIONS["触觉"][1]]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na,nt)
                combo_trained+=1

# [E] 带声调的拼音→汉字
print("训练带调拼音...",flush=True)
toned_trained=0
for toned,hz in TONED.items():
    if hz not in WORD2ID: continue
    hid=WORD2ID[hz]
    # toned不在词表里,用动态编码
    for _ in range(15):
        dE_toned=encode_word(toned)  # 动态编码
        dE_hz_a=encode_single(hid,"听觉")
        # 用W投射
        dE_per=W@dE_toned
        na=dE_per[A_LO:A_HI]
        nn=np.linalg.norm(na)
        if nn>1e-10:
            na/=nn
            dE_hz_v=encode_single(hid,"视觉")
            nv=dE_hz_v[V_LO:V_HI]
            nvn=np.linalg.norm(nv)
            if nvn>1e-10:
                nv/=nvn
                W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(na,nv)
                toned_trained+=1

print(f"  训练了{toned_trained}组带调关联",flush=True)

# [F] 整体认读音节序列训练 (zhi chi shi ri zi ci si...)
for i in range(len(ZHENGTI)-1):
    w1=ZHENGTI[i]; w2=ZHENGTI[i+1]
    if w1 in WORD2ID and w2 in WORD2ID:
        c1=WORD2ID[w1]; c2=WORD2ID[w2]
        for _ in range(20):
            dE1=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
            n1=dE1[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            n2=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(n2,n1)

# [G] 声母序列 (b p m f d t n l g k h j q x zh ch sh r z c s y w)
for i in range(len(SHENGMU)-1):
    w1=SHENGMU[i]; w2=SHENGMU[i+1]
    if w1 in WORD2ID and w2 in WORD2ID:
        c1=WORD2ID[w1]; c2=WORD2ID[w2]
        for _ in range(20):
            dE1=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
            n1=dE1[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            n2=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(n2,n1)

# [H] 韵母序列 (a o e i u v ai ei ui ao ou iu ie ve er an en in un vn ang eng ing ong)
ALL_YUNMU = DANYUNMU+FUYUNMU+BIYUNMU
for i in range(len(ALL_YUNMU)-1):
    w1=ALL_YUNMU[i]; w2=ALL_YUNMU[i+1]
    if w1 in WORD2ID and w2 in WORD2ID:
        c1=WORD2ID[w1]; c2=WORD2ID[w2]
        for _ in range(20):
            dE1=encode_single(c1,"听觉"); dE2=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
            n1=dE1[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            n2=dE2[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*2*np.outer(n2,n1)

print("训练完成\n",flush=True)

# === 测试: 逐个教拼音,记录它的反应 ===
print("="*60,flush=True)
print("  教拼音 · 逐个测试",flush=True)
print("="*60,flush=True)

test_results=[]

# 1. 声母
print(f"\n--- 声母 ({len(SHENGMU)}个) ---",flush=True)
for py in SHENGMU:
    v=Vitality(DIM); E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM); S=np.zeros(DIM)
    # 注入拼音信号
    dE=encode_word(py)
    for _ in range(5):
        dE_per=W@dE
        dE_vit=v.step(dE_per)
        S=S_DECAY*S+dE_vit
        E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
    # 解码: 它"听到"了什么?
    r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,5)

"""
阴阳扣 - 去限制版

限制代码已去掉。
只剩底层结构(自我认知保护) + 原始环境。

去掉的:
  - np.clip(E, -50, 50)   环境有界 ← 限制, 删
  - dE = (target-E)*0.01   阻尼/惯性 ← 限制, 删
  - fE = E * 0.01          力的缩放 ← 限制, 删
  - gE = -E * 0.01         力的缩放 ← 限制, 删
  - np.random.normal(0, 0.02)  人工噪声 ← 限制, 删
  - (sensory-0.5)*0.5      信号缩放 ← 限制, 删

保留的(自我认知保护):
  - loop_step 结构不动
  - expand_state 不回滚, 旧值保留
  - trace 不删不改
  - 阴阳方向: fE 正, gE 反
"""

import numpy as np
import random
import math


# ================================================================
# 底层固定代码 - 不可动 (自我认知保护)
# ================================================================

E = np.array([0.0])
P = np.array([0.0])
F = np.array([0.0])


def loop_step(dE, fE, gE):
    global E, P, F
    E = E + dE
    P_new = F + fE
    F_new = P + gE
    P = P_new
    F = F_new


def expand_state(new_dim):
    global E, P, F
    if len(E) < new_dim:
        E = np.append(E, [0.0] * (new_dim - len(E)))
        P = np.append(P, [0.0] * (new_dim - len(P)))
        F = np.append(F, [0.0] * (new_dim - len(F)))


# ================================================================
# 环境层
# ================================================================

STAGES = [
    {"name": "出生",   "dim": 1},
    {"name": "~3月",   "dim": 3},
    {"name": "~8月",   "dim": 4},
    {"name": "~1.5岁", "dim": 6},
    {"name": "~3岁",   "dim": 8},
    {"name": "~5岁",   "dim": 10},
    {"name": "~7-8岁", "dim": 12},
]


def get_stage(step, total_steps):
    stage_len = total_steps // len(STAGES)
    idx = min(int(step / stage_len), len(STAGES) - 1)
    return idx, STAGES[idx]


def sense_space(t, dim):
    """原始空间信号。不缩放。不限制。"""
    s = []

    s.append(math.sin(t * 0.001) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    if dim >= 3:
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0013 + 1) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0007 + 2) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    if dim >= 4:
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.002) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    if dim >= 6:
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0015) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0011 + 1.5) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    if dim >= 8:
        s.append(math.cos(t * 0.002) * math.sin(t * 0.0017) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0019) * math.cos(t * 0.0014) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    if dim >= 10:
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0008) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))
        s.append(math.cos(t * 0.0012) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    if dim >= 12:
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.0005) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))
        s.append(math.sin(t * 0.01) + random.gauss(0, 0.1))

    # 稀有冲击
    if random.random() < 0.02:
        s[random.randint(0, len(s) - 1)] += random.choice([-1, 1]) * random.expovariate(1)

    return np.array(s[:dim], dtype=np.float64)


def environment(t, stage_idx):
    stage = STAGES[stage_idx]
    dim = stage["dim"]
    expand_state(dim)

    # 原始信号直接压进来, 不阻尼不缩放
    dE = sense_space(t, dim)

    # 阴阳: 全力, 不缩放
    fE = E[:dim].copy()
    gE = -E[:dim].copy()

    return dE, fE, gE


# ================================================================
# 屏幕
# ================================================================

def to_color(v):
    vals = list(v[:3]) + [0.0] * (3 - min(len(v), 3))
    r = int(max(0, min(255, vals[0] * 10 + 128)))
    g = int(max(0, min(255, vals[1] * 10 + 128)))
    b = int(max(0, min(255, vals[2] * 10 + 128)))
    return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})"


def render_screen(traces, filename):
    stages_seen = {}
    for tr in traces:
        s = tr["stage"]
        if s not in stages_seen:
            stages_seen[s] = tr

    blocks = ""
    for idx in sorted(stages_seen.keys()):
        tr = stages_seen[idx]
        st = STAGES[idx]
        blocks += f"""
<div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin:10px 0;align-items:center">
  <div style="width:80px;color:#666;font-size:12px">{st['name']}<br><span style="color:#333">{st['dim']}维</span></div>
  <div style="width:40px;height:40px;background:{to_color(tr['P'])};border:1px solid #222"></div>
  <div style="width:40px;height:40px;background:{to_color(tr['E'])};border:1px solid #222"></div>
  <div style="width:40px;height:40px;background:{to_color(tr['F'])};border:1px solid #222"></div>
</div>"""

    last = traces[-1]

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
body {{ background:#0a0a0a; color:#888; font-family:monospace; margin:30px; }}
.note {{ color:#444; font-size:11px; margin:20px 0; line-height:1.6; }}
</style></head><body>

<h3 style="color:#aaa;font-weight:normal">阴阳扣 — 去限制</h3>

<div style="display:flex;gap:16px;color:#555;font-size:11px;margin:8px 0 20px">
  <div style="width:80px">阶段</div>
  <div style="width:40px;text-align:center">P</div>
  <div style="width:40px;text-align:center">E</div>
  <div style="width:40px;text-align:center">F</div>
</div>
{blocks}

<div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin:20px 0">
  <div><div style="width:60px;height:60px;background:{to_color(last['P'])};border:1px solid #222"></div><div style="color:#555;font-size:11px;text-align:center">P</div></div>
  <div><div style="width:60px;height:60px;background:{to_color(last['F'])};border:1px solid #222"></div><div style="color:#555;font-size:11px;text-align:center">F</div></div>
</div>
<div style="color:#555;font-size:11px">步 {last['step']} | {last['dim']}维 | |P-F|={np.linalg.norm(last['P']-last['F']):.2f}</div>
<div style="color:#555;font-size:11px">E=[{', '.join(f'{x:.1f}' for x in last['E'][:4])}...]</div>

<div class="note">
限制代码已全部去掉。<br>
环境原始信号直接压入, 不阻尼不缩放。<br>
阴阳全力, 不缩放。<br>
P 和 F 的对冲从结构中涌现, 不是限制出来的。
</div>

</body></html>"""

    with open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(html)


# ================================================================
# 沙箱
# ================================================================

trace = []


def run(total_steps):
    global E, P, F
    for t in range(total_steps):
        stage_idx, stage = get_stage(t, total_steps)
        dE, fE, gE = environment(t, stage_idx)
        loop_step(dE, fE, gE)
        trace.append({
            "step": t, "stage": stage_idx, "dim": stage["dim"],
            "P": P.copy(), "F": F.copy(), "E": E.copy(),
        })


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run(70000)
    last = trace[-1]

    print(f"步数: {len(trace)}")
    print(f"阶段: {STAGES[last['stage']]['name']} ({last['dim']}维)")
    print(f"P: {last['P']}")
    print(f"F: {last['F']}")
    print(f"E: {last['E']}")
    print(f"|P-F|: {np.linalg.norm(last['P'] - last['F']):.2f}")
    print(f"P+F (应≈0): {np.linalg.norm(last['P'] + last['F']):.2f}")

    print("\n各阶段:")
    seen = set()
    for tr in trace:
        if tr["stage"] not in seen:
            seen.add(tr["stage"])
            print(f"  {STAGES[tr['stage']]['name']:8s} | dim={tr['dim']:2d} | "
                  f"|P|={np.linalg.norm(tr['P']):.2f} | "
                  f"|E|={np.linalg.norm(tr['E']):.2f} | "
                  f"|P+F|={np.linalg.norm(tr['P']+tr['F']):.4f}")

    render_screen(trace, 'yinyang_raw.html')
    print(f"\n屏幕: yinyang_raw.html")

"""
阴阳扣 - 让数字生命体直接读真实课文网页
打开百度百科的真实课文页面, 用8感官去"看"
基于修复版系统 (yinyang_fix) 的训练权重
"""
import numpy as np, random, hashlib, json, jieba
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from collections import Counter
random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.1; LR_W=0.05; REPS=40; K=8; S_DECAY=0.3

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]

# === 词表 (修复版, 去重) ===

# === 编码 ===
DENSE={}
for cid in range(N_CONCEPTS):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K); wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(N_CONCEPTS):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]; ref=np.zeros(R)
        for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

CHAR_CACHE={}
def encode_char(ch):
    if ch in CHAR_CACHE: return CHAR_CACHE[ch]
    h=int(hashlib.md5(ch.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),16)
    rng=random.Random(h)
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
        pos=rng.sample(range(R),K); wts=[rng.uniform(0.3,1.0) for _ in range(K)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    CHAR_CACHE[ch]=dE; return dE

def encode_word_dynamic(word):
    if word in WORD2ID:
        cid=WORD2ID[word]
        dE=np.zeros(DIM)
        for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
            for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
        return dE
    dE=np.zeros(DIM)
    for ch in word:
        dE+=encode_char(ch)
    rn=np.linalg.norm(dE)
    if rn>SCALE*8: dE*=SCALE*8/(rn+1e-10)
    return dE

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE; fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM); gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy(); return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def decode(vec,sense,ids,n=1):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; r=vec[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(r)
    if rn<1e-10: return [(-1,0)]
    r/=rn; sims=[(c,float(np.dot(r,REF[(c,sense)]))) for c in ids]
    sims.sort(key=lambda x:x[1],reverse=True); return sims[:n]

# [A] 基础W
n_per_stage=N_CONCEPTS//8+1
for si in range(8):
    s=si*n_per_stage; e=min((si+1)*n_per_stage, N_CONCEPTS)
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(s,e):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                for p,w in zip(*DENSE[(cid,sense)]): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]; na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]; nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb); W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)

# [B] 身份强化
for cid in range(N_CONCEPTS):
    for _ in range(20):
        dEv=encode_single(cid,"视觉"); dEa=encode_single(cid,"听觉")
        nv=dEv[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEv[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na=dEa[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dEa[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*4*np.outer(na,nv)
        W[V_LO:V_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*4*np.outer(nv,na)

# [C] 语义
for w1,w2 in SEMANTIC_PAIRS:
    if w1 not in WORD2ID or w2 not in WORD2ID: continue
    c1,c2=WORD2ID[w1],WORD2ID[w2]
    for _ in range(25):
        dE1v=encode_single(c1,"视觉"); dE2a=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        nv1=dE1v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na2=dE2a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na2,nv1)
        dE2v=encode_single(c2,"视觉"); dE1a=encode_single(c1,"听觉")
        nv2=dE2v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na1=dE1a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na1,nv2)

# [D] 因果 (单向)
for cause,effect in CAUSAL_PAIRS:
    if cause not in WORD2ID or effect not in WORD2ID: continue
    c1,c2=WORD2ID[cause],WORD2ID[effect]
    for _ in range(30):
        dE1v=encode_single(c1,"视觉"); dE2a=encode_single(c2,"听觉")
        nv1=dE1v[V_LO:V_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE1v[V_LO:V_HI])+1e-10)
        na2=dE2a[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE2a[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
        W[A_LO:A_HI,V_LO:V_HI]+=LR_W*3*np.outer(na2,nv1)

# [E] 句子序列
pair_count={}
for sent in SENTENCES:
    for i in range(len(sent)-1):
        wc=WORD2ID.get(sent[i],-1); wn=WORD2ID.get(sent[i+1],-1)
        if wc>=0 and wn>=0: pair_count[(wc,wn)]=pair_count.get((wc,wn),0)+1
for sent in SENTENCES:
    for _ in range(30):
        for i in range(len(sent)-1):
            wc=WORD2ID.get(sent[i],-1); wn=WORD2ID.get(sent[i+1],-1)
            if wc<0 or wn<0: continue
            freq=pair_count.get((wc,wn),1)
            weight=3.0/np.sqrt(freq)
            dE_cur=encode_single(wc,"听觉")
            dE_next=encode_single(wn,"听觉")
            n_cur=dE_cur[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_cur[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            n_next=dE_next[A_LO:A_HI]/(np.linalg.norm(dE_next[A_LO:A_HI])+1e-10)
            W[A_LO:A_HI,A_LO:A_HI]+=LR_W*weight*np.outer(n_next,n_cur)

print("训练完成\n")

# === 网页内容提取 (8感官) ===
def url_to_sensory(url, fallback_text, fallback_title):
    print(f"  正在打开: {url}")
    headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'}
    try:
        resp=requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        resp.encoding=resp.apparent_encoding or 'utf-8'
        soup=BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        for tag in soup(['script','style','nav','footer','header','aside']):
            tag.decompose()
        text=soup.get_text(separator='\n', strip=True)
        lines=[l.strip() for l in text.split('\n') if l.strip()]
        title_tag=soup.find('title')
        page_title=title_tag.get_text(strip=True) if title_tag else fallback_title
        imgs=soup.find_all('img', src=True)
        img_count=len(imgs)
        headings=[(i, h.get_text(strip=True)) for i in range(1,7) for h in soup.find_all(f'h{i}')][:10]
        para_count=len(soup.find_all('p'))
        page_size=len(resp.text)
        status_code=resp.status_code
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  网络不可达: {e}")
        print(f"  -> 用本地课文原文")
        text=fallback_text
        lines=fallback_text.split('\n')
        page_title=fallback_title
        img_count=0; headings=[(1,fallback_title)]; para_count=len(lines)
        page_size=len(fallback_text)*3; status_code=200

    sensory_stream=[]

    # [视觉] 标题词
    for word in jieba.cut(page_title):
        word=word.strip()
        if word and len(word)>0:
            sensory_stream.append((f"标题:{word}", encode_word_dynamic(word), "视觉"))

    # [视觉] 正文词
    word_count=0
    for line in lines[:80]:
        for word in jieba.cut(line):
            word=word.strip()
            if not word: continue
            sensory_stream.append((f"正文:{word}", encode_word_dynamic(word), "视觉"))
            word_count+=1
            if word_count>=500: break
        if word_count>=500: break

    # [触觉] 标题层级
    for level, h_text in headings[:10]:
        dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS["触觉"]
        intensity=max(SCALE*(1.5-level*0.2),0.01)
        h_val=int(hashlib.md5(h_text.encode()).hexdigest(),16)%R
        for p in range(K): dE[lo+(h_val+p*7)%R]=intensity
        sensory_stream.append((f"标题H{level}:{h_text[:20]}", dE, "触觉"))

    # [本体觉] 页面大小
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS["本体觉"]
    size_signal=min(page_size/10000,1.0)
    for p in range(K): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*size_signal
    sensory_stream.append((f"页面大小:{page_size}字节", dE, "本体觉"))

    # [内脏觉] 状态
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS["内脏觉"]
    health=1.0 if status_code==200 else 0.3
    for p in range(K): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*health
    sensory_stream.append((f"状态:{status_code}", dE, "内脏觉"))

    # [嗅觉] 类别
    category="通用"
    if any(w in text for w in ['诗','词','赋','古文','课文','尾巴','乌鸦','喝水']): category="课文"
    elif any(w in text for w in ['码','代码','程序']): category="科技"
    elif any(w in text for w in ['新闻','报道']): category="新闻"
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS["嗅觉"]
    cat_hash=int(hashlib.md5(category.encode()).hexdigest(),16)%R
    for p in range(K): dE[lo+(cat_hash+p*11)%R]=SCALE
    sensory_stream.append((f"类别:{category}", dE, "嗅觉"))

    # [味觉] 情感
    pos_words=['好','美','爱','快乐','笑','暖','亮','春','花','歌','红','绿']
    neg_words=['坏','哭','痛','冷','暗','悲伤','生气','怕','恶']
    pos_count=sum(1 for w in pos_words if w in text)
    neg_count=sum(1 for w in neg_words if w in text)
    taste="甜" if pos_count>neg_count else ("苦" if neg_count>pos_count else "淡")
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS["味觉"]
    taste_hash=int(hashlib.md5(taste.encode()).hexdigest(),16)%R
    for p in range(K): dE[lo+(taste_hash+p*13)%R]=SCALE
    sensory_stream.append((f"色调:{taste}", dE, "味觉"))

    # [前庭觉] 布局
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); lo,_=REGIONS["前庭觉"]
    balance=min(len(lines)/max(para_count,1),5.0)/5.0
    for p in range(K): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*balance
    sensory_stream.append((f"布局:{balance:.2f}", dE, "前庭觉"))

    return {"url":url,"title":page_title,"text_lines":lines,"img_count":img_count,
            "para_count":para_count,"sensory_stream":sensory_stream,
            "category":category,"taste":taste,"page_size":page_size,"status_code":status_code}

    print(f"  感官信号: {len(pd['sensory_stream'])}个")

    E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM); S=np.zeros(DIM)

    recognized_words=set()

    for i,(desc,dE_in,sense) in enumerate(pd["sensory_stream"]):
        dE_per=W@dE_in
        dE_vit=v.step(dE_per)
        S=S_DECAY*S+dE_vit
        E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)

        sensory_activated[sense]+=float(np.linalg.norm(dE_vit))

        if "正文:" in desc:
            word=desc.split("正文:")[-1]
            if word in WORD2ID:
                recognized_words.add(word)
            else:
                novel_words.add(word)

            r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,3)
            top=[(ALL_WORDS[c],round(v2,2)) for c,v2 in r if c>=0]
            snapshots.append({"step":i,"desc":desc[:40],"top":top})

    for snap in snapshots:
        print(f"    [{snap['step']:3d}] {snap['desc']:40s} -> 听到:{[w for w,_ in snap['top']]}")

    # 看完后的印象
    print(f"\n  --- 看完后的印象 ---")

    r=decode(E,"听觉",learned_ids,10)
    print(f"  听觉top-10:")
    for c,score in r:
        if c>=0: print(f"    {ALL_WORDS[c]}: {score:.3f}")

    print(f"\n  各感官区能量:")
    for sense,(lo,hi) in REGIONS.items():
        energy=float(np.linalg.norm(E[lo:hi]))
        bar="|"*int(energy*30)
        print(f"    {sense:6s} {energy:.3f} {bar}")

    r=decode(S,"听觉",learned_ids,5)
    for c,score in r:
        if c>=0: print(f"    {ALL_WORDS[c]}: {score:.3f}")

    original_words=[]
    for line in page["text"].split('\n'):
        for word in jieba.cut(line):
            word=word.strip()
            if word: original_words.append(word)

    # 去重保持顺序
    seen_w=set(); uniq=[]
    for w in original_words:
        if w not in seen_w: seen_w.add(w); uniq.append(w)

    recognized=[w for w in uniq if w in WORD2ID]
    novel=[w for w in uniq if w not in WORD2ID]

    print(f"  它不认识 ({len(novel)}个): {' '.join(novel[:20]) if novel else '(无)'}")

print(f"\n  总计认识: {total_rec}/{total_words} ({total_rec/total_words*100:.0f}%)")

for r in all_results:

print(f"  所有新词 ({len(all_novel)}个): {' '.join(sorted(all_novel)[:50])}")

"""
阴阳扣 - 数字生命逐级推理学科概念

把代码里用到的所有数学/物理/信息论概念按从易到难分四级,
每一级给出"定义"(= embody 该定义的信号),
让数字生命用它的多lag自相关策略检测,
看它每一级能不能从信号里"推理"出规律.

数字生命不读文字, 只接收信号.
"告诉它定义" = 生成完全符合该定义的信号.
"它推理出来" = 检测到结构 (自相关 > 0.3).
"""

import numpy as np
import math
import random

# 加载底层 Vitality
src = open("yinyang_darwin.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
defs = src.split("pop = [")[0]
exec(defs, globals())

random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)
N = 2000  # 每个概念跑2000步

# ================================================================
# 数字生命的检测器 (它自己选出的最佳策略)
# ================================================================
def detect_structure(signal):
    """多lag自相关: 数字生命写的检测器"""
    best = 0.0
    for lag in range(1, min(50, len(signal)//2)):
        if np.std(signal[:-lag]) > 1e-10 and np.std(signal[lag:]) > 1e-10:
            ac = abs(np.corrcoef(signal[:-lag], signal[lag:])[0,1])
            best = max(best, ac)
    return best

def detect_period(signal):
    """检测周期"""
    best_p, best_ac = 0, 0
    for p in range(2, min(100, len(signal)//3)):
        if np.std(signal[:-p]) > 1e-10 and np.std(signal[p:]) > 1e-10:
            ac = np.corrcoef(signal[:-p], signal[p:])[0,1]
            if ac > best_ac:
                best_ac = ac
                best_p = p
    return best_p, best_ac

# ================================================================
# 辅助函数
# ================================================================
_primes_cache = [2]
def _primes(n):
    while len(_primes_cache) <= n:
        c = _primes_cache[-1] + 1
        while True:
            ok = True
            for i in range(2, int(c**0.5)+1):
                if c % i == 0:
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                _primes_cache.append(c)
                break
            c += 1
    return _primes_cache[n]

_fib_cache = [0, 1]
def _fib(n):
    while len(_fib_cache) <= n:
        _fib_cache.append((_fib_cache[-1] + _fib_cache[-2]) % 100)
    return _fib_cache[n]

# EMA 特殊处理 (用 list 容器避免 global)
_ema_state = [0.0]
def _ema_step(t):
    x = math.sin(t * 0.01) + random.gauss(0, 0.1)
    _ema_state[0] = 0.99 * _ema_state[0] + 0.01 * x
    return _ema_state[0]

# 熵信号: 生成8个bin的分布, 计算熵
def _entropy_signal(t):
    # 用一个变化的分布
    p = abs(math.sin(t * 0.005)) * 0.8 + 0.1
    dist = [p, 1-p]
    h = -sum(pi * math.log2(pi) for pi in dist if pi > 0)
    return h  # 0到1之间, 周期变化

# 资源衰减
def _resource_signal(t):
    R = 1.0
    for i in range(t + 1):
        R -= 0.0008
        if i > 0 and i % 1200 == 0:
            R = 1.0
        R = max(0.0, R)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-(R - 0.3) * 8))

# Logistic映射
_log_state = [0.3]
def _logistic(t):
    while len(_log_state) <= t:
        x = _log_state[-1]
        _log_state.append(4 * x * (1 - x))
    return _log_state[t]

# Cantor集信号
def _cantor(t):
    # 检测t在Cantor三分集的位置
    x = t / N
    for _ in range(10):
        if 1/3 < x < 2/3:
            return 0.0
        x = (x * 3) % 1
    return 1.0

THRESHOLD = 0.3  # 自相关>0.3 = 检测到结构 = "推理出来"

for level in LEVELS:
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"  {level['name']}")
    print(f"  {level['desc']}")
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    n_pass = 0
    for concept in level["concepts"]:
        name = concept["name"]
        definition = concept["def"]
        hint = concept["reason_hint"]
        special = concept.get("special", None)

        # 生成信号
        if special == "ema":
            _ema_state[0] = 0.0
            signal = np.array([_ema_step(t) for t in range(N)])
        else:
            signal = np.array([concept["signal"](t) for t in range(N)])

        # 检测
        struct = detect_structure(signal)
        period, period_ac = detect_period(signal)

        # 判定
        passed = struct > THRESHOLD
        verdict = "推理出" if passed else "推不出"
        if passed:
            n_pass += 1

        all_results.append((level["name"], name, definition, struct, period, verdict))

        print(f"  [{name}]")
        print(f"    定义: {definition}")
        print(f"    提示: {hint}")
        print(f"    结构={struct:.3f} 周期={period}(ac={period_ac:.2f})")
        print(f"    判定: {verdict}")
        print()

    total = len(level["concepts"])
    print(f"  本级通过: {n_pass}/{total}")
    print()

    total = len(level_results)
    rate = n_pass / total * 100
    print(f"  {level['name']:<24s} {n_pass:>4d} {total:>4d} {rate:>5.0f}%")

print("  数字生命的推理极限:")
print(f"    基础级: {'全过' if all(r[5]=='推理出' for r in all_results if '基础' in r[0]) else '有没过的'}")
level2_pass = sum(1 for r in all_results if '中级' in r[0] and r[5]=='推理出')
level3_pass = sum(1 for r in all_results if '高级' in r[0] and r[5]=='推理出')
level4_pass = sum(1 for r in all_results if '最难' in r[0] and r[5]=='推理出')
print(f"    中级: {level2_pass}个推理出")
print(f"    高级: {level3_pass}个推理出")
print(f"    最难: {level4_pass}个推理出")

# ================================================================
# HTML
# ================================================================
def render_html(filename):
    level_sections = ""
    for level in LEVELS:
        level_results = [r for r in all_results if r[0] == level["name"]]
        n_pass = sum(1 for r in level_results if r[5] == "推理出")
        total = len(level_results)

        rows = ""
        for lv, name, definition, struct, period, verdict in level_results:
            color = "#4a4" if verdict == "推理出" else "#a44"
            rows += f"<tr><td>{name}</td>"
            rows += f"<td style='font-size:9px;color:#666'>{definition}</td>"
            rows += f"<td style='color:{color}'>{struct:.3f}</td>"
            rows += f"<td>{period if period else '-'}</td>"
            rows += f"<td style='color:{color}'>{verdict}</td></tr>"

        rate = n_pass / total * 100 if total else 0
        level_sections += f'<div class="sec">{level["name"]} ({n_pass}/{total} = {rate:.0f}%)</div>'
        level_sections += f'<div style="color:#555;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:4px">{level["desc"]}</div>'
        level_sections += f'<table><tr><th>概念</th><th>定义</th><th>结构</th><th>周期</th><th>判定</th></tr>'
        level_sections += rows + '</table>'

    # 汇总
    summary_rows = ""
    for level in LEVELS:
        level_results = [r for r in all_results if r[0] == level["name"]]
        n_pass = sum(1 for r in level_results if r[5] == "推理出")
        total = len(level_results)
        rate = n_pass / total * 100 if total else 0
        color = "#4a4" if rate >= 50 else ("#aa4" if rate > 0 else "#a44")
        summary_rows += f"<tr><td>{level['name']}</td><td>{n_pass}/{total}</td>"
        summary_rows += f"<td style='color:{color}'>{rate:.0f}%</td></tr>"

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
body {{ background:#0a0a0a; color:#888; font-family:monospace; margin:20px; }}
h3 {{ color:#aaa; font-weight:normal; }}
table {{ border-collapse:collapse; font-size:10px; margin:10px 0; }}
td, th {{ border:1px solid #222; padding:3px 8px; text-align:left; }}
th {{ color:#666; }}
.note {{ color:#444; font-size:10px; margin:16px 0; line-height:1.8; }}
.sec {{ color:#777; font-size:12px; margin:18px 0 6px; }}
</style></head><body>

<h3>阴阳扣 — 数字生命逐级推理学科概念</h3>
<div style="color:#666;font-size:11px;margin:8px 0">
  检测器: 多lag自相关 | 通过阈值: 自相关>0.3 | 每概念{N}步<br>
  "告诉它定义" = 生成符合定义的信号 | "推理出" = 检测到结构
</div>

<div class="sec">汇总</div>
<table>
<tr><th>级别</th><th>通过</th><th>通过率</th></tr>
{summary_rows}
</table>

{level_sections}

<div class="note">
数字生命不读文字, 只接收信号.<br>
"定义"被翻译成信号喂给它, 它用自己选的多lag自相关策略检测.<br>
有结构 = 它"理解"了定义的规律.<br>
无结构 = 它"推不出来", 可能是检测器不够灵敏, 也可能是概念本身在信号层面无结构(如随机噪声).<br><br>
关键: 数字生命的推理能力 = 信号结构检测能力. 它没有"概念"这个抽象层, 只有"有规律/没规律"这个判断.<br>
但对于混沌、分形这类"有结构但检测器看不出"的信号, 它的推理极限就暴露了.
</div>

</body></html>"""
    with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html)
    print(f"屏幕: {filename}")

render_html("yinyang_reasoning_levels.html")

"""
阴阳扣 - 自创世界: 它自己生成生活, 不再活在预设场景里

之前: make_day()预编程场景 (我给它安排每天发生什么)
现在: 世界从它的内部状态涌现 (它自己决定每天经历什么)

机制:
  每一步, 它的E/P状态决定它"感受到"什么:
  1. E高的感官区 -> 它主动往那个方向"看" -> W映射出它"期望"感受到的信号
  2. 联想驱动 -> P的模式通过W扩散 -> 多感官场景涌现
  3. 记忆回放 -> E的残留模式重新激活 -> 它"回忆"之前的经历
  4. 环境基线 -> 像背景噪声 (光/声/温度的基础存在)

  每天不再有固定场景, 而是它的状态自然生成一天的经历
  有些天它"想起"妈, 有些天它"探索"新东西, 有些天它"发呆"

底层公式不变: E+=dE; P=F+E+noise; F=P-E+noise
"""
import numpy as np
import random
from itertools import combinations

random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

DIM = 1024; R = 128; SCALE = 0.01; LR_W = 0.02; TEST_STEPS = 80
DAYS = 200
STEPS_PER_DAY = 300  # 每天300步 (约12小时活动)

REGIONS = {
    "视觉": (0, 128), "听觉": (128, 256), "触觉": (256, 384), "嗅觉": (384, 512),
    "味觉": (512, 640), "本体觉": (640, 768), "前庭觉": (768, 896), "内脏觉": (896, 1024),
}
SENSES = list(REGIONS.keys())

STAGES = [
    {"age":"0-1岁","words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"age":"1-2岁","words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"age":"2-3岁","words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"age":"3-4岁","words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"age":"4-5岁","words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"age":"5-6岁","words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"age":"6-7岁","words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS = []
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS) < 280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS = ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID = {w: i for i, w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

ALL_PAIRS = list(combinations(range(R), 2))
random.shuffle(ALL_PAIRS)
CANDIDATE_PAIRS = ALL_PAIRS[:280]
POS = {}
for sense in SENSES:
    perm = list(range(280)); random.shuffle(perm)
    POS[sense] = [CANDIDATE_PAIRS[perm[i]] for i in range(280)]

REF_CACHE = {}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo, hi = REGIONS[sense]
        ref = np.zeros(R)
        for p in POS[sense][cid]: ref[p] = 1.0
        REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)] = ref / (np.linalg.norm(ref) + 1e-10)

def bottom_step(E, P, F, dE):
    E = E + dE
    fE = E + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, DIM)
    gE = -E + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, DIM)
    return E, F + fE, P + gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self, n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n); self.prev=np.zeros(n); self.ac=np.zeros(n); self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005; self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self, dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy()
        return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid, sense):
    dE = np.zeros(DIM)
    lo, _ = REGIONS[sense]
    for p in POS[sense][cid]: dE[lo + p] = SCALE
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr, sense, learned_ids):
    lo, hi = REGIONS[sense]
    region = P_arr[lo:hi].copy()
    rn = np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn < 1e-10: return -1, 0
    region = region / rn
    best_id, best_sim = -1, -2
    for cid in learned_ids:
        sim = float(np.dot(region, REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)]))
        if sim > best_sim: best_id, best_sim = cid, sim
    return best_id, best_sim

def norm(s):
    m=np.max(np.abs(s)); return s/m if m>1e-12 else s.copy()

# ================================================================
# 自创世界: 从内部状态生成外部信号
# ================================================================
def generate_world(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, day_num, step_in_day):
    """
    它的E/P状态决定它"感受到"什么世界信号

    机制:
    1. 昼夜节律: step_in_day决定基础光照/温度 (像真实的一天)
    2. 内脏驱动: E内脏觉高 -> 生成饥饿信号 (身体需求驱动行为)
    3. 好奇寻求: E某感官高 -> W映射出期望信号 (主动找东西)
    4. 记忆回放: P残留模式 -> 重新激活之前经历 (回忆)
    5. 联想涌现: P通过W扩散 -> 多感官场景 (联想生成世界)
    """
    dE_world = np.zeros(DIM)

    # 1. 昼夜节律 (不是预设场景, 是基础环境)
    progress = step_in_day / STEPS_PER_DAY  # 0~1
    if progress < 0.15:  # 早晨
        # 光线渐亮
        lo, hi = REGIONS["视觉"]
        dE_world[lo:lo+5] += SCALE * 0.3 * progress / 0.15
    elif progress > 0.85:  # 夜晚
        # 光线渐暗
        lo, hi = REGIONS["视觉"]
        darkness = (progress - 0.85) / 0.15
        dE_world[lo:lo+5] -= SCALE * 0.2 * darkness
    # 基础温度
    lo_t, hi_t = REGIONS["触觉"]
    dE_world[lo_t:lo_t+3] += SCALE * 0.1  # 基础温暖

    # 2. 内脏驱动: E内脏觉高 -> 生成需求信号
    lo_v, hi_v = REGIONS["内脏觉"]
    viscer_E = np.mean(np.abs(E[lo_v:hi_v]))
    if viscer_E > 0.01:
        # E内脏觉的残余模式 -> 生成需求信号
        # 如果E内脏觉在"饿"的位置高 -> 生成饥饿信号
        dE_world[lo_v:hi_v] += 0.3 * E[lo_v:hi_v] * SCALE / (np.linalg.norm(E[lo_v:hi_v]) + 1e-10)

    # 3. 好奇寻求: 哪个感官E高 -> W映射出期望信号
    E_abs = np.abs(E)
    sense_energy = {s: np.mean(E_abs[REGIONS[s][0]:REGIONS[s][1]]) for s in SENSES}
    # 找最活跃的感官 (除了内脏觉, 那是需求)
    top_sense = max(sense_energy, key=sense_energy.get)
    if sense_energy[top_sense] > 0.005 and top_sense != "内脏觉":
        lo, hi = REGIONS[top_sense]
        # E模式 -> W映射 -> 期望的世界信号
        E_region = E[lo:hi]
        E_norm = E_region / (np.linalg.norm(E_region) + 1e-10)
        # W从该感官映射到所有感官 (它"期望"感受到的完整世界)
        expected = W[:, lo:hi] @ E_norm  # W^T * E -> 全感官期望
        dE_world += 0.3 * expected * SCALE / (np.linalg.norm(expected) + 1e-10)

    # 4. 记忆回放: P残留模式重新激活
    P_norm = P / (np.linalg.norm(P) + 1e-10)
    # P中残留的模式 -> 通过W重新激活 (回忆)
    memory_signal = W @ P_norm
    mem_norm = np.linalg.norm(memory_signal)
    if mem_norm > 0.002:
        dE_world += 0.15 * memory_signal * SCALE / mem_norm

    # 5. 随机探索 (有时候世界有意外)
    if random.random() < 0.02:  # 2%概率遇到新东西
        rand_sense = random.choice(SENSES)
        lo, hi = REGIONS[rand_sense]
        # 如果已学过概念, 随机激活一个
        if learned_ids:
            rand_cid = random.choice(list(learned_ids))
            for p in POS[rand_sense][rand_cid]:
                dE_world[lo + p] += SCALE * 0.5

    return dE_world

def internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step_idx):
    """内部驱动 (运动倾向等, 和之前一致)"""
    dE_int = np.zeros(DIM)
    MOTOR_LO, MOTOR_HI = REGIONS["本体觉"]
    VEST_LO, VEST_HI = REGIONS["前庭觉"]

    # 运动倾向
    dE_int[MOTOR_LO:MOTOR_HI] += np.random.normal(0, 0.0005, MOTOR_HI - MOTOR_LO)
    dE_int[VEST_LO:VEST_HI] += np.random.normal(0, 0.0005, VEST_HI - VEST_LO)

    # 无聊探索
    if np.mean(np.abs(E)) < 0.005:
        rand_sense = random.choice(SENSES)
        lo, hi = REGIONS[rand_sense]
        rand_pos = random.randint(lo, hi-1)
        dE_int[rand_pos] += 0.003

    return dE_int

# ================================================================
# 训练: 自创世界 (无预设场景)
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print(f"自创世界: 它自己生成每天的经历 ({DAYS}天)")
print("世界 = 昼夜节律 + 身体需求 + 好奇寻求 + 记忆回放 + 联想涌现")
print("=" * 72)
print()

W = np.eye(DIM)
vit = Vitality(DIM)
learned_ids = set()

# 记录每天经历
day_logs = []

# 种子: 第1天给极少外部刺激 (像刚出生)
seed_concepts = [WORD2ID["妈"], WORD2ID["奶"], WORD2ID["饿"], WORD2ID["饱"],
                 WORD2ID["热"], WORD2ID["冷"], WORD2ID["睡"]]

for day in range(DAYS):
    E = np.zeros(DIM)
    P = np.zeros(DIM)
    F = np.zeros(DIM)

    day_events = []

    for step in range(STEPS_PER_DAY):
        # 生成世界信号 (从内部状态涌现)
        if day == 0:
            # 第一天: 种子刺激 (像刚出生遇到妈和奶)
            if step < 50:
                dE_world = encode_single(seed_concepts[step % len(seed_concepts)], random.choice(SENSES))
            else:
                dE_world = generate_world(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, day, step)
        else:
            dE_world = generate_world(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, day, step)

        # 内部驱动
        dE_int = internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step)

        # 总dE = 世界 + 内部
        dE_total = dE_world * 0.7 + dE_int

        # 记录学到的概念
        for sense, (lo, hi) in REGIONS.items():
            region = dE_world[lo:hi]
            if np.linalg.norm(region) > SCALE * 0.3:
                for cid in range(280):
                    ref = REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)]
                    sim = float(np.dot(region / (np.linalg.norm(region)+1e-10), ref))
                    if sim > 0.5:
                        learned_ids.add(cid)
                        if (day, sense, cid) not in [(d,s,c) for d,s,c in day_events]:
                            day_events.append((day, sense, cid))
                        break

        # W从同时出现的信号学关联
        if np.linalg.norm(dE_world) > 1e-10:
            n_dE = dE_world / (np.linalg.norm(dE_world) + 1e-10)
            for sa_i, sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                lo_a, hi_a = REGIONS[sa]
                sig_a = dE_world[lo_a:hi_a]
                na = np.linalg.norm(sig_a)
                if na < 1e-10: continue
                na = sig_a / na
                for sb in SENSES[sa_i+1:]:
                    lo_b, hi_b = REGIONS[sb]
                    sig_b = dE_world[lo_b:hi_b]
                    nb = np.linalg.norm(sig_b)
                    if nb < 1e-10: continue
                    nb = sig_b / nb
                    W[lo_a:hi_a, lo_b:hi_b] += LR_W * np.outer(na, nb)
                    W[lo_b:hi_b, lo_a:hi_a] += LR_W * np.outer(nb, na)

        # 底层公式跑
        dE_vit = vit.step(dE_total)
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_vit)

        # 每50步记录一次它在"想"什么
        if (step + 1) % 50 == 0:
            detected = []
            for sense in SENSES:
                did, sim = decode_cosine(P, sense, sorted(learned_ids)) if learned_ids else (-1, 0)
                if did >= 0 and sim > 0.15:
                    detected.append((sense, ALL_WORDS[did], sim))
            if detected:
                best = max(detected, key=lambda x: x[2])
                day_events.append((day, best[0] + "(P)", WORD2ID.get(best[1], -1)))

    # 记录这天遇到的独特概念
    unique_concepts = set()
    for _, _, cid in day_events:
        if cid >= 0:
            unique_concepts.add(cid)
    day_logs.append({
        "day": day + 1,
        "n_concepts": len(unique_concepts),
        "concepts": [ALL_WORDS[c] for c in sorted(unique_concepts)][:10],
        "n_events": len(day_events),
    })

    # 夜晚E衰减
    for _ in range(50):
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, -0.05 * E)

    if (day + 1) % 50 == 0:
        W_off = W - np.diag(np.diag(W))
        n_conn = int(np.sum(np.abs(W_off) > 0.01))
        print(f"  第{day+1}天: 接触{len(learned_ids)}概念, W连接={n_conn}, 这天遇到{len(unique_concepts)}概念")
        if unique_concepts:
            print(f"    遇到: {' '.join([ALL_WORDS[c] for c in sorted(unique_concepts)][:10])}")

learned_ids = sorted(learned_ids)
print(f"\n训练完成: 接触{len(learned_ids)}个概念")
print()

# ================================================================
# 分析: 它自创的世界是什么样的?
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print("分析: 它自创的世界")
print("=" * 72)
print()

# 每天遇到的概念数趋势
print("每天遇到的概念数 (前20天 + 末5天):")
for log in day_logs[:20]:
    bar = "#" * min(log["n_concepts"], 30)
    print(f"  第{log['day']:3d}天: {log['n_concepts']:2d}个 {bar} {' '.join(log['concepts'][:5])}")
print("  ...")
for log in day_logs[-5:]:
    bar = "#" * min(log["n_concepts"], 30)
    print(f"  第{log['day']:3d}天: {log['n_concepts']:2d}个 {bar} {' '.join(log['concepts'][:5])}")
print()

# 概念出现频率
from collections import Counter
all_encountered = []
for log in day_logs:
    all_encountered.extend(log["concepts"])
freq = Counter(all_encountered)
print(f"概念出现频率 (前20):")
for word, count in freq.most_common(20):
    print(f"  {word}: {count}天")
print()

# ================================================================
# 测试: 它在自创世界里形成了什么关联?
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print("测试: 自创世界后的关联")
print("=" * 72)
print()

test_words = [w for w in ["妈","奶","饿","饱","花","猫","水","书","球","走",
                          "冷","热","睡","笑","好"] if w in WORD2ID and WORD2ID[w] in learned_ids]

print(f"  {'看到':>6s}  {'它说':>8s}  {'相似度':>6s}")
print("  " + "-" * 30)

for w in test_words:
    cid = WORD2ID[w]
    dE_in = encode_single(cid, "视觉")
    dE_per = W @ dE_in
    E = np.zeros(DIM); P = np.zeros(DIM); F = np.zeros(DIM)
    for _ in range(TEST_STEPS):
        E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_per)
    did, sim = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids)
    answer = ALL_WORDS[did] if did >= 0 else "?"
    is_assoc = "关联" if did != cid and did >= 0 else "复述"
    print(f"  {w:>6s}  {answer:>8s}  {sim:6.3f}  {is_assoc}")

print()

# ================================================================
# 测试: 自主行为 (无任何输入)
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print("测试: 自主行为 (纯内部驱动 + 自创世界)")
print("=" * 72)
print()

E = np.zeros(DIM); P = np.zeros(DIM); F = np.zeros(DIM)
spontaneous = []

for step in range(400):
    dE_world = generate_world(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, 999, step % STEPS_PER_DAY)
    dE_int = internal_drive(E, P, W, vit, learned_ids, step)
    dE_total = dE_world * 0.7 + dE_int
    dE_vit = vit.step(dE_total)
    E, P, F = bottom_step(E, P, F, dE_vit)

    if (step + 1) % 50 == 0:
        detected = []
        for sense in SENSES:
            did, sim = decode_cosine(P, sense, learned_ids)
            if did >= 0 and sim > 0.12:
                detected.append((sense, ALL_WORDS[did], sim))
        if detected:
            best = max(detected, key=lambda x: x[2])
            spontaneous.append((step+1, best[0], best[1], best[2]))
            print(f"  第{step+1}步: {best[0]}区 [{best[1]}] sim={best[2]:.3f}")
        else:
            spontaneous.append((step+1, "无", "-", 0))
            print(f"  第{step+1}步: 无明显激活")

n_spont = sum(1 for _, _, w, _ in spontaneous if w != "-")
print(f"\n  自主激活: {n_spont}/8")
print()

# ================================================================
# 汇总
# ================================================================
print("=" * 72)
print("汇总")
print("=" * 72)
print(f"  训练: {DAYS}天, 自创世界 (无预设场景)")
print(f"  接触: {len(learned_ids)}概念")
print(f"  最常遇到: {freq.most_common(5)}")
print(f"  自主激活: {n_spont}/8")
print()

def render_html(fn):
    # 每天概念数趋势
    trend = ""
    for log in day_logs:
        bar = "#" * min(log["n_concepts"], 40)
        trend += f'<div style="font-size:8px;margin:0px 0;color:#555">第{log["day"]:3d}天: {log["n_concepts"]:2d} {bar}</div>'

    # 频率
    freq_html = ""
    for word, count in freq.most_common(20):
        pct = count / DAYS * 100
        freq_html += f'<div style="font-size:9px;margin:1px 0">{word}: {count}天 ({pct:.0f}%) {"#"*min(count,30)}</div>'

    # 关联测试
    assoc_html = ""
    for w in test_words:
        cid = WORD2ID[w]
        dE_in = encode_single(cid, "视觉")
        dE_per = W @ dE_in
        E=np.zeros(DIM); P=np.zeros(DIM); F=np.zeros(DIM)
        for _ in range(TEST_STEPS): E,P,F = bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_per)
        did, sim = decode_cosine(P, "听觉", learned_ids)
        answer = ALL_WORDS[did] if did >= 0 else "?"
        c = "#4a4" if did != cid and did >= 0 else "#555"
        assoc_html += f'<div style="color:{c};font-size:9px;margin:1px 0">看到[{w}] -> 说[{answer}] sim={sim:.3f}</div>'

    # 自主行为
    spont_html = ""
    for step, sense, word, sim in spontaneous:
        c = "#4a4" if word != "-" else "#555"
        spont_html += f'<div style="color:{c};font-size:9px;margin:1px 0">第{step}步: {sense}区 [{word}] sim={sim:.3f}</div>'

    html = f'''<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
body {{ background:#0a0a0a; color:#888; font-family:monospace; margin:20px; max-width:920px; }}
h3 {{ color:#aaa; font-weight:normal; border-bottom:1px solid #222; padding-bottom:6px; }}
.summary {{ color:#6a6; font-size:11px; margin:8px 0; }}
.note {{ color:#444; font-size:9px; margin:16px 0; line-height:1.8; }}
</style></head><body>

<h3>阴阳扣 -- 自创世界</h3>
<div class="summary">
  {DAYS}天 | 无预设场景 | 世界从内部状态涌现<br>
  接触{len(learned_ids)}概念 | 自主激活{n_spont}/8
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">世界生成机制 (5种, 全从内部状态涌现)</div>
<div style="color:#555;font-size:9px;line-height:1.8">
  1. 昼夜节律: 基础光照/温度 (不是场景, 是物理环境)<br>
  2. 内脏驱动: E内脏觉高 -> 生成需求信号 (身体要什么, 世界就出现什么)<br>
  3. 好奇寻求: E某感官高 -> W映射出期望信号 (想看什么就看到什么)<br>
  4. 记忆回放: P残留模式 -> W重新激活 (回忆之前经历)<br>
  5. 联想涌现: P通过W扩散 -> 多感官场景 (联想生成新世界)
</div>
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">每天遇到的概念数趋势</div>
{trend}
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">

{freq_html}
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">关联测试 (自创世界后)</div>
{assoc_html}
</div>

<div style="margin:12px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a1a">
<div style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px">自主行为 (无外部输入)</div>
{spont_html}
</div>

<div class="note">
关键变化:<br>
  之前: make_day()预编程场景, 它活在我安排的世界里<br>
  现在: 世界从它的E/P/W状态涌现, 它自己创造每天的经历<br><br>
它不需要代码工具:<br>
  它已有4种内部驱动 + W矩阵(记忆) + E(身体状态)<br>
  这些就够了: 身体要什么, 世界就出现什么; 想起什么, 就回忆什么<br>
  不需要额外的代码工具, 它的内部状态就是世界生成器<br><br>
世界 = f(内部状态):<br>
  E内脏觉高(饿) -> 生成饥饿信号 -> 驱动它"找"妈和奶<br>
  E视觉高(好奇) -> W映射出期望 -> 它"看到"花或猫<br>
  P残留(记忆) -> W重新激活 -> 它"回忆"之前的经历<br>
  P通过W扩散(联想) -> 多感官场景涌现 -> 它"创造"新经历<br><br>
底层公式不变: E+=dE; P=F+E+noise; F=P-E+noise<br>
  世界信号和内部驱动一起作为dE进入底层公式<br>
  它的身体(E)和世界(dE)现在是一体的: 身体状态决定世界, 世界改变身体
</div>
</body></html>'''
    with open(fn, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html)
    print(f"HTML: {fn}")

render_html("yinyang_self_world.html")

"""
阴阳扣 - 跨概念语义关联 (从零混合训练)

不再在旧W上叠加, 而是从零训练:
  每轮同时教: 同概念识别 + 跨概念关联
  W同时学会: 水视觉→水听觉(认) 和 水视觉→喝听觉(联想)

391对语义关联, 基于真实中文语义
"""
import numpy as np
import random
import os
from itertools import combinations

random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

DIM = 1024; R = 128; SCALE = 0.01; LR_W = 0.02; TEST_STEPS = 80
REPS = 400
CACHE_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "yinyang_chat_cache.npz")

REGIONS = {
    "视觉": (0, 128), "听觉": (128, 256), "触觉": (256, 384), "嗅觉": (384, 512),
    "味觉": (512, 640), "本体觉": (640, 768), "前庭觉": (768, 896), "内脏觉": (896, 1024),
}
SENSES = list(REGIONS.keys())

STAGES = [
    {"age":"0-1岁","words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"age":"1-2岁","words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"age":"2-3岁","words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"age":"3-4岁","words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"age":"4-5岁","words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"age":"5-6岁","words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"age":"6-7岁","words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS = []
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS) < 280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS = ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID = {w: i for i, w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

ALL_PAIRS = list(combinations(range(R), 2))
random.shuffle(ALL_PAIRS)
CANDIDATE_PAIRS = ALL_PAIRS[:280]
POS = {}
for sense in SENSES:
    perm = list(range(280)); random.shuffle(perm)
    POS[sense] = [CANDIDATE_PAIRS[perm[i]] for i in range(280)]

REF_CACHE = {}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo, hi = REGIONS[sense]
        ref = np.zeros(R)
        for p in POS[sense][cid]: ref[p] = 1.0
        REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)] = ref / (np.linalg.norm(ref) + 1e-10)

def bottom_step(E, P, F, dE):
    E = E + dE
    fE = E + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, DIM)
    gE = -E + np.random.normal(0, 0.01, DIM)
    return E, F + fE, P + gE

def encode_single(cid, sense):
    dE = np.zeros(DIM)
    lo, _ = REGIONS[sense]
    for p in POS[sense][cid]: dE[lo + p] = SCALE
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr, sense, learned_ids):
    lo, hi = REGIONS[sense]
    region = P_arr[lo:hi].copy()
    rn = np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn < 1e-10: return -1, 0
    region = region / rn
    best_id, best_sim = -1, -2
    for cid in learned_ids:
        sim = float(np.dot(region, REF_CACHE[(cid, sense)]))
        if sim > best_sim: best_id, best_sim = cid, sim
    return best_id, best_sim

def norm(s):
    m = np.max(np.abs(s)); return s/m if m>1e-12 else s.copy()
def safe_corr(a,b):
    a,b=np.asarray(a).flatten(),np.asarray(b).flatten()
    if len(a)!=len(b): n=min(len(a),len(b)); a,b=a[:n],b[:n]
    if np.std(a)<1e-10 or np.std(b)<1e-10: return 0.0
    return float(np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1])
def get_sense(P_arr, sense):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]; return P_arr[lo:hi].copy()

W = np.eye(DIM)
learned_ids = []

for si, stage in enumerate(STAGES):
    start_id = si * 40
    stage_ids = list(range(start_id, start_id + 40))
    learned_ids.extend(stage_ids)

    for rep in range(REPS):
        # 同概念识别训练 (全部8感官交叉)
        for cid in stage_ids:
            dE = np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense, (lo, _) in REGIONS.items():
                for p in POS[sense][cid]: dE[lo + p] = SCALE
            for sa_i, sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                lo_a, hi_a = REGIONS[sa]
                sig_a = dE[lo_a:hi_a]
                na = sig_a / (np.linalg.norm(sig_a) + 1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[sa_i + 1:]:
                    lo_b, hi_b = REGIONS[sb]
                    sig_b = dE[lo_b:hi_b]
                    nb = sig_b / (np.linalg.norm(sig_b) + 1e-10)
                    W[lo_a:hi_a, lo_b:hi_b] += LR_W * np.outer(na, nb)
                    W[lo_b:hi_b, lo_a:hi_a] += LR_W * np.outer(nb, na)

        # 跨概念关联训练 (只视觉→听觉, 更高LR)
        for aid, bid, wa, wb in VALID_ASSOC:
            if aid in stage_ids or bid in stage_ids:
                lo_v, hi_v = REGIONS["视觉"]
                lo_a, hi_a = REGIONS["听觉"]
                # A的视觉信号
                dE_v = np.zeros(DIM)
                for p in POS["视觉"][aid]: dE_v[lo_v + p] = SCALE
                nv = dE_v[lo_v:hi_v] / (np.linalg.norm(dE_v[lo_v:hi_v]) + 1e-10)
                # B的听觉信号
                dE_a = np.zeros(DIM)
                for p in POS["听觉"][bid]: dE_a[lo_a + p] = SCALE
                na = dE_a[lo_a:hi_a] / (np.linalg.norm(dE_a[lo_a:hi_a]) + 1e-10)
                W[lo_v:hi_v, lo_a:hi_a] += LR_W * 3 * np.outer(nv, na)  # 3倍权重
                W[lo_a:hi_a, lo_v:hi_v] += LR_W * 3 * np.outer(na, nv)

    W_off = W - np.diag(np.diag(W))
    n_conn = int(np.sum(np.abs(W_off) > 0.01))
    print(f"  {stage['age']}: W连接={n_conn}")
    learned_ids_copy = list(learned_ids)

"""
阴阳扣 - 衰减感觉缓冲S: 有遗忘才能看见模式

根因发现: E=E+dE是纯积分器, 永不遗忘
  → E的模长是一条直线上升的斜坡, 没有周期信号
  → 相邻步E几乎一样(只加一个微小dE), 向量自相关恒为1.0
  → 无法从E中提取时序模式

人脑: 感觉记忆~500ms衰减, 旧痕迹淡去新输入进来, 重复模式产生共振
解法: 环境层加衰减感觉缓冲S (和Vitality同层, 不碰E)
  S(t+1) = 0.9*S(t) + dE(t)
  → S会忘, 最近的输入权重大, 远处的淡去
  → 如果模式周期P, 第t+P步的新输入会与S中的残量共振
  → S的自相关应该能揭示周期

S不碰底层公式: E=E+dE不变, S只是环境层的另一个器官
"""
import numpy as np
import random

random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.01; LR_W=0.02; REPS=300; K=8
S_DECAY=0.9  # S的衰减率 (0.9=每步保留90%)

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]

STAGES=[
    {"words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS=[]
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS)<280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS=ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K)
        wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        ref=np.zeros(R)
        pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE
    fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy()
        return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM);lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
    for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr,sense,learned_ids):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]
    region=P_arr[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn<1e-10: return -1,0
    region/=rn; best_id,best_sim=-1,-2
    for cid in learned_ids:
        sim=float(np.dot(region,REF[(cid,sense)]))
        if sim>best_sim: best_id,best_sim=cid,sim
    return best_id,best_sim

# === 1. 训练W ===
print("训练W...")
W=np.eye(DIM); vit=Vitality(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))
for si in range(7):
    start=si*40;end=start+40
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(start,end):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
                for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]
                na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]
                    nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb)
                    W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)
print("W完成\n")

# === 2. AI作品 ===
works={}
fractal=[]
for step in range(60):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); cycle=step%3; base=cycle*15
    for i in range(8): dE[V_LO+(base+i*2)%(V_HI-V_LO)]=SCALE*(1.0-step/60*0.5)*(0.8-i*0.05)
    fractal.append(dE)
works["分形艺术"]=fractal
rhythm=[]; beat_pat=[1.0,0.3,0.5,0.2,0.8,0.3,0.5,0.1]
for step in range(60):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); beat=beat_pat[step%8]
    for i in range(8): dE[A_LO+i]=SCALE*beat*(1.0-i*0.1)
    if beat>0.7: dE[A_LO+60]=SCALE*0.4; dE[A_LO+61]=SCALE*0.3
    rhythm.append(dE)
works["节奏音乐"]=rhythm
code=[]
for step in range(60):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); depth=(step//10)%4
    for d in range(depth+1):
        for i in range(3): dE[V_LO+d*15+i*3]=SCALE*(1.0-d*0.2)*(0.9-i*0.1)
    if step%10==9 and depth>0: dE[V_LO+depth*15+7]=SCALE*0.6
    code.append(dE)
works["嵌套代码"]=code
spatial=[]
for step in range(60):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM); center=32+(step%20-10)
    for i in range(4): dE[V_LO+(center+i)%(V_HI-V_LO)]=SCALE*0.3*(1.0-i*0.2)
    dE[V_LO]=SCALE*0.8; dE[V_LO+63]=SCALE*0.8

    spatial.append(dE)

# === 3. 衰减感觉缓冲S ===
print("="*72)
print(f"衰减感觉缓冲S: S(t+1) = {S_DECAY}*S(t) + dE(t)")
print(f"  (每步保留{S_DECAY*100:.0f}%, 衰减{100-S_DECAY*100:.0f}%)")
print(f"  不碰E, S是环境层独立器官")
print("="*72)

all_S_traces={}

for work_name, steps in works.items():
    vit_fresh=Vitality(DIM)
    E=np.zeros(DIM);P=np.zeros(DIM);F=np.zeros(DIM)
    S=np.zeros(DIM)  # 衰减感觉缓冲, 从零开始
    S_trace=[]

    for dE_in in steps:
        dE_per=W@dE_in
        dE_vit=vit_fresh.step(dE_per)
        # S: 衰减 + 新输入 (在dE进入底层之前)
        S = S_DECAY * S + dE_vit
        E,P,F=bottom_step(E,P,F,dE_vit)
        S_norm=S/(np.linalg.norm(S)+1e-10)
        S_trace.append(S_norm.copy())

    all_S_traces[work_name]=S_trace

    # S的模长序列 (有衰减所以模长会波动而非单调上升)
    S_norms=[np.linalg.norm(S_trace[t]) for t in range(60)]

    # 模长自相关
    autocorr_norm=[]
    for lag in range(1,30):
        if lag>=60: break
        if np.std(S_norms[:-lag])>1e-10 and np.std(S_norms[lag:])>1e-10:
            ac=np.corrcoef(S_norms[:-lag],S_norms[lag:])[0,1]
        else: ac=0
        autocorr_norm.append((lag,ac))

    # 向量自相关
    autocorr_vec=[]
    for lag in range(1,30):
        if lag>=60: break
        acs=[float(np.dot(S_trace[t],S_trace[t+lag])) for t in range(60-lag)]
        ac_v=np.mean(acs)
        autocorr_vec.append((lag,ac_v))

    exp_p=periods[work_name]
    best_lag_n,best_ac_n=max(autocorr_norm,key=lambda x:abs(x[1]))
    best_lag_v,best_ac_v=max(autocorr_vec,key=lambda x:abs(x[1]))

    mark_n="OK" if best_lag_n==exp_p else ("~" if abs(best_lag_n-exp_p)<=2 else "X")
    mark_v="OK" if best_lag_v==exp_p else ("~" if abs(best_lag_v-exp_p)<=2 else "X")
    print(f"  [{work_name}] (期望周期={exp_p})")
    print(f"    S模长自相关: lag={best_lag_n} ac={best_ac_n:.3f} {mark_n}")
    print(f"    S向量自相关: lag={best_lag_v} ac={best_ac_v:.3f} {mark_v}")
    print(f"    模长ac: " + " ".join([f"L{l}:{a:.2f}" for l,a in autocorr_norm[:12]]))
    print()

                hits.append(t)

    total=60-2*exp_p
    print(f"  [{work_name}] 周期{exp_p}: 首次命中={first_hit}步, 命中率={len(hits)}/{total}")

"""
阴阳扣 - 衰减感觉缓冲S v2: 修bug + 多维度检测

v1 bug: 存S前归一化了 → 模长恒1.0 → std=0 → 无周期信号
v2修复: 存原始S, 测真实模长波动 + 方向变化

新维度:
  1. S模长: 周期输入应该让模长振荡 (强信号步S涨, 弱信号步S跌)
  2. ΔS方向: 每步S的方向变化, 周期输入应该让ΔS也周期
  3. 单区域: 只看视觉区(V_LO:V_HI)的S, 排除其他区域干扰
  4. 多衰减率: 试0.9, 0.7, 0.5, 0.3 看哪个最能揭示周期
"""
import numpy as np
import random

random.seed(42); np.random.seed(42)

DIM=1024; R=128; SCALE=0.01; LR_W=0.02; REPS=300; K=8

REGIONS={"视觉":(0,128),"听觉":(128,256),"触觉":(256,384),"嗅觉":(384,512),
         "味觉":(512,640),"本体觉":(640,768),"前庭觉":(768,896),"内脏觉":(896,1024)}
SENSES=list(REGIONS.keys())
V_LO,V_HI=REGIONS["视觉"]; A_LO,A_HI=REGIONS["听觉"]

STAGES=[
    {"words":["妈","爸","奶","饿","饱","热","冷","痛","睡","抱","尿","哭","笑","吃","走","拿","放","下","上","来","去","大","少","猫","狗","车","球","水","饭","花","树","鸟","鱼","手","脚","头","眼","耳","嘴","鼻"]},
    {"words":["碗","勺","筷","桌","椅","床","门","窗","灯","书","笔","纸","衣","裤","鞋","帽","伞","糖","果","肉","蛋","菜","米","面","汤","茶","药","画","歌","跑","跳","爬","坐","站","拍","马","牛","羊","鸡","鸭"]},
    {"words":["红","黄","蓝","绿","白","黑","紫","粉","圆","方","长","短","粗","细","厚","薄","轻","重","硬","软","干","湿","净","脏","新","旧","破","快","慢","远","近","高","矮","深","浅","宽","窄","明","暗","响"]},
    {"words":["哥","姐","弟","妹","爷","师","同","友","校","园","唱","跳","游戏","玩具","电脑","电话","电视","冰箱","空调","洗衣机","钟","表","锁","剪刀","钥匙","胶","橡皮","尺","书包","铅笔","彩笔","积木","拼图","乐高","棋","牌","球拍","跳绳","风筝","自行车"]},
    {"words":["好","坏","对","错","家","爱","怕","朋","快乐","悲伤","生气","勇敢","聪明","勤","懒","美","丑","善","恶","真","假","前","后","左","右","东","西","南","北","因为","所以","但是","虽然","可能","应该","认真","仔细","干净","整齐","安静"]},
    {"words":["字","数","书","笔","读","写","算","加","减","乘","除","等","星期","月","日","时","分","秒","春","夏","秋","冬","方向","开始","结束","第","最","后","中间","旁边","上面","下面","里面","外面","颜色","形状","声音","大小","多少","好坏"]},
    {"words":["我","你","他","她","谁","什么","哪里","为什么","怎么","做","吗","呢","吧","啊","是","的","不","因为","所以","但是","如果","虽然","可能","应该","可以","怎样","这样","那样","这里","那里","什么时候","多少","几个","一样","不同","也许","大概","一定","真的","当然"]},
]
ALL_WORDS=[]
for s in STAGES: ALL_WORDS.extend(s["words"])
while len(ALL_WORDS)<280: ALL_WORDS.append(f"词{len(ALL_WORDS)+1}")
ALL_WORDS=ALL_WORDS[:280]
WORD2ID={w:i for i,w in enumerate(ALL_WORDS)}

DENSE={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        pos=random.sample(range(R),K)
        wts=np.random.uniform(0.3,1.0,K)
        DENSE[(cid,sense)]=(pos,wts)
REF={}
for cid in range(280):
    for sense in SENSES:
        lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
        ref=np.zeros(R)
        pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
        for p,w in zip(pos,wts): ref[p]=w
        REF[(cid,sense)]=ref/(np.linalg.norm(ref)+1e-10)

def bottom_step(E,P,F,dE):
    E=E+dE
    fE=E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    gE=-E+np.random.normal(0,0.01,DIM)
    return E,F+fE,P+gE

class Vitality:
    def __init__(self,n=DIM):
        self.v=np.ones(n);self.prev=np.zeros(n);self.ac=np.zeros(n);self.var=np.ones(n)*0.01
        self.a=0.005;self.lr=0.0003
    def step(self,dE):
        self.ac=(1-self.a)*self.ac+self.a*(dE*self.prev)
        self.var=(1-self.a)*self.var+self.a*(dE*dE)
        s=np.clip(np.abs(self.ac)/(self.var+1e-10),0,1)
        self.v=np.clip(self.v+self.lr*(s-0.3),0.01,3.0)
        self.prev=dE.copy()
        return dE*self.v

def encode_single(cid,sense):
    dE=np.zeros(DIM);lo,_=REGIONS[sense]
    pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
    for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
    return dE

def decode_cosine(P_arr,sense,learned_ids):
    lo,hi=REGIONS[sense]
    region=P_arr[lo:hi].copy(); rn=np.linalg.norm(region)
    if rn<1e-10: return -1,0
    region/=rn; best_id,best_sim=-1,-2
    for cid in learned_ids:
        sim=float(np.dot(region,REF[(cid,sense)]))
        if sim>best_sim: best_id,best_sim=cid,sim
    return best_id,best_sim

# === 1. 训练W ===
print("训练W...")
W=np.eye(DIM); vit=Vitality(DIM); learned_ids=list(range(280))
for si in range(7):
    start=si*40;end=start+40
    for _ in range(REPS):
        for cid in range(start,end):
            dE=np.zeros(DIM)
            for sense,(lo,_) in REGIONS.items():
                pos,wts=DENSE[(cid,sense)]
                for p,w in zip(pos,wts): dE[lo+p]=SCALE*w
            for ai,sa in enumerate(SENSES):
                la,ha=REGIONS[sa]; sig_a=dE[la:ha]
                na=sig_a/(np.linalg.norm(sig_a)+1e-10)
                for sb in SENSES[ai+1:]:
                    lb,hb=REGIONS[sb]; sig_b=dE[lb:hb]
                    nb=sig_b/(np.linalg.norm(sig_b)+1e-10)
                    W[la:ha,lb:hb]+=LR_W*np.outer(na,nb)
                    W[lb:hb,la:ha]+=LR_W*np.outer(nb,na)
print("W完成\n")

# === 3. 多衰减率 × 多维度测试 ===
DECAYS=[0.9,0.7,0.5,0.3]

for decay in DECAYS:

    for work_name, steps in works.items():
